#2. Fig 1
##2.1 Fig 1c. 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

plot_data <- FSEOF_target

# keep top 25% by predicted_change (not absolute)
cutoff <- quantile(plot_data$predicted_change, 0.85, na.rm = TRUE)

plot_data_top <- plot_data %>%
  filter(predicted_change >= cutoff) %>%
  mutate(
    FinalAnnotation = fct_reorder(FinalAnnotation, abs(predicted_change), .desc = TRUE)
  )

plot_data_top$predicted_change[plot_data_top$category=="Knockout"] = -plot_data_top$predicted_change[plot_data_top$category=="Knockout"]

plot_data_top <- plot_data_top %>%
  mutate(FinalAnnotation = forcats::fct_reorder(FinalAnnotation, abs(predicted_change), .desc = T))


f1c <- ggplot(plot_data_top, aes(x = FinalAnnotation, y = predicted_change, fill = proteinType)) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Predicted change") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) 
f1c
ggsave('Figure_1c.svg' , f1c, width = 8, height = 2)
```
## 2.2 Fig 1d.
```{r}
# Packages
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(fgsea)

# ---- 1) Prepare gene-level stats (one value per gene) ----
# FSEOF_target must have: GQ_names (gene IDs) and predicted_change (numeric)
temp <- FSEOF_target
temp$predicted_change[temp$category=="Knockout"] = -temp$predicted_change[temp$category=="Knockout"]
gene_stats <- temp %>%
  filter(!is.na(GQ_names), !is.na(predicted_change)) %>%
  group_by(GQ_names) %>%
  summarise(stat = mean(predicted_change), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(stat))

stats <- setNames(gene_stats$stat, gene_stats$GQ_names)

# ---- 2) Read pathways from GMT and keep only those overlapping your genes ----
GO_file <- "figure_data/goSLIMmod.gmt"
pathways_all <- fgsea::gmtPathways(GO_file)

# keep pathways with at least 5 overlapping genes (tweak min size as needed)
pathways <- lapply(pathways_all, function(genes) intersect(genes, names(stats)))
pathways <- pathways[ vapply(pathways, length, integer(1)) >= 5 ]

# ---- 3) Run GSEA ----
set.seed(1)
fg <- fgsea(
  pathways = pathways,
  stats    = stats,
  minSize  = 3,
  maxSize  = 500,
  nperm    = 10000
)

# ---- 4) Compute mean predicted_change and pathway sizes for plotting ----
path_summary <- tibble(
  pathway = names(pathways),
  n_genes = vapply(pathways, length, integer(1)),
  mean_predicted_change = vapply(pathways, function(g)
    mean(stats[g], na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1))
)

plot_df <- fg %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(pathway, padj) %>%                 # padj is the FDR from fgsea
  left_join(path_summary, by = "pathway") %>%
  # OPTIONAL: keep the top 30 by |mean change| for readability
  arrange(desc(abs(mean_predicted_change))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 30) %>%
  mutate(
    pathway = fct_reorder(pathway, mean_predicted_change), # y ordered by mean change
    log10FDR = -log10(padj)                                  # color = log(FDR)
    # If you prefer conventional significance coloring, use: neglog10FDR = -log10(padj)
  )

plot_df_filtered <- plot_df[plot_df$log10FDR > -log10(0.05), ]
# ---- 5) Dotplot ----
f1d <- ggplot(plot_df_filtered, aes(x = mean_predicted_change, y = pathway)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_genes, color = log10FDR)) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean predicted change",
    y = NULL,
    color = "log10(FDR)",
    size = "# genes"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)) + 
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#400045", high = "#d8b365")
f1d
ggsave('Figure_1d.svg' , f1d, width = 3.5, height = 1)
```

#3. Fig 2
##3.1 Fig 2a. 
```{r}
AllStrainCultivationResults <- read_excel("figure_data/StrainCultivationResultCompilation.xlsx")

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(janitor)

# ---- 1) Normalize & map category -> Modification equivalence ----
# Map per your spec:
# "Upregulation"           -> "Upregulation"
# "Mixed, Upregulation"    -> "Upregulation"
# "Mixed, Knockout"        -> "Knockout"
# "Knockout"               -> "Knockout"
map_category_to_mod <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "Upregulation"         ~ "Upregulation",
    x == "Mixed, Upregulation"  ~ "Upregulation",
    x == "Mixed, Knockout"      ~ "Knockout",
    x == "Knockout"             ~ "Knockout",
    TRUE                        ~ NA_character_
  )
}

FSEOF_clean <- FSEOF_target %>%
  mutate(
    .gene_key = str_to_upper(str_trim(as.character(GQ_names))),
    .mod_map  = str_to_upper(map_category_to_mod(category))  # mapped category
  ) %>%
  # drop rows where category doesn't map (optional; prevents NA join keys)
  filter(!is.na(.mod_map))

Cult_clean <- AllStrainCultivationResults %>%
  mutate(
    .gene_key = str_to_upper(str_trim(as.character(Gene))),
    .rp_key   = str_to_upper(str_trim(as.character(RecombinantProtein))),
    .mod_key  = str_to_upper(str_trim(as.character(Modification)))
  )

# ---- 2) Core overlap: genes where mapped category matches Modification, for HSA ----
HSA_overlap_core <- FSEOF_clean %>%
  inner_join(
    Cult_clean,
    by = c(".gene_key" = ".gene_key", ".mod_map" = ".mod_key"),
    suffix = c(".FSEOF", ".Cult")
  ) %>%
  filter(.rp_key == "HSA")

# ---- 3) Add all HSA Control rows (regardless of category mapping) ----
HSA_controls <- FSEOF_clean %>%
  right_join(
    Cult_clean %>% filter(.rp_key == "HSA", .mod_key == "CONTROL"),
    by = c(".gene_key" = ".gene_key"),
    suffix = c(".FSEOF", ".Cult")
  )

# ---- 4) Combine, clean helper cols, de-dup ----
HSA_overlap <- bind_rows(HSA_overlap_core, HSA_controls) %>%
  select(-.gene_key, -.rp_key, -.mod_key, -.mod_map) %>%
  distinct()

HSA_overlap <- clean_names(HSA_overlap)
temp <- HSA_overlap$predicted_change>8
temp[is.na(temp)] <- T
HSA_overlap <- HSA_overlap[temp, ]

# Optional: remove exact duplicate rows if the join creates many-to-many matches
# HSA_overlap <- HSA_overlap %>% distinct()
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
})

# --- NEW: for heatmap colored x-labels (optional) ---
ggtext_available <- requireNamespace("ggtext", quietly = TRUE)

# =========================
# Parameters (colors & fonts)
# =========================
mod_colors <- c(
  "UPREGULATION" = "#5ab4ac",
  "KNOCKOUT"     = "#d8b365",
  # CHANGED: Control light grey instead of black
  "CONTROL"      = "#bdbdbd"
)

pt10_mm <- 10 / 2.845
pt12_mm <- 12 / 2.845
axis_text_size   <- 10
axis_title_size  <- 12
legend_text_size <- 10
legend_title_size <- 10
star_size_mm <- pt10_mm

repcols_for_base <- function(df, base) {
  grep(paste0("^", base, "_\\d+$"), names(df), value = TRUE)
}

make_label <- function(mod_key, label_src, control_label = "Control", delta_symbol = "\u0394") {
  up_arrow <- "↑"; Encoding(up_arrow) <- "UTF-8"   # ← literal arrow + set encoding
  dplyr::case_when(
    mod_key == "CONTROL"      ~ control_label,
    mod_key == "UPREGULATION" ~ paste0(label_src),
    mod_key == "KNOCKOUT"     ~ paste0(label_src),
    TRUE ~ label_src
  )
}



compute_one_sided_bh_vs_control <- function(values_by_label, control_label = "Control") {
  ctrl_vals <- values_by_label %>%
    dplyr::filter(.label == control_label) %>%
    dplyr::pull(value)
  if (length(ctrl_vals) < 2) {
    return(values_by_label %>% dplyr::distinct(.label) %>% dplyr::mutate(pval = NA_real_, padj = NA_real_))
  }
  raw <- values_by_label %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.label) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(
      pval = tryCatch({
        if (.label[1] == control_label) NA_real_
        else {
          x <- value
          if (length(x) < 2) NA_real_
          else stats::t.test(x, ctrl_vals, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "greater")$p.value
        }
      }, error = function(e) NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  idx <- !is.na(raw$pval) & raw$.label != control_label
  padj <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(raw))
  if (any(idx)) padj[idx] <- p.adjust(raw$pval[idx], method = "BH")
  raw$padj <- padj
  raw
}

# --- NEW: shared x-levels helper (Control first, then descending predicted_change) ---
# REPLACE the bad name compute_x_levelscompute_x_levels with this:
compute_x_levels <- function(
  df,
  control_label = "Control",
  mod_col  = "modification",
  label_source_col = "final_annotation_cult",
  predicted_col = "predicted_change",
  delta_symbol = "\u0394"
) {
  df_lab <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      .mod_key = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_trim(.data[[mod_col]])),
      .label   = make_label(.mod_key, .data[[label_source_col]], control_label, delta_symbol)
    )

  order_df <- df_lab %>%
    dplyr::distinct(.label, .mod_key, .data[[predicted_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.label, .mod_key) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(predicted_change = suppressWarnings(dplyr::first(na.omit(.data[[predicted_col]]))), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(is_control = (.mod_key == "CONTROL"),
                  predicted_change = ifelse(is_control, NA_real_, predicted_change))

  non_ctrl <- order_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is_control) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(predicted_change)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(.label)

  c(control_label, setdiff(non_ctrl, control_label))
}

# IMPORTANT: rebuild after the arrow-label change
x_levels_shared <- compute_x_levels(
  HSA_overlap,
  control_label = "Control",
  mod_col = "modification",
  label_source_col = "final_annotation_cult",
  predicted_col = "predicted_change"
)
print(x_levels_shared)


# --- MOD: let plots accept a precomputed x_levels (shared ordering) & optional legend toggle ---
plot_bar_by_mod <- function(
  df, col_base,
  y_label,
  do_one_tailed_BH = FALSE,
  gene_col = "gene",
  mod_col  = "modification",
  label_source_col = "final_annotation_cult",
  control_label = "Control",
  predicted_col = "predicted_change",
  place_control_first = TRUE,     # kept for API compatibility; ignored when x_levels provided
  delta_symbol = "\u0394",
  x_levels = NULL,                # <-- NEW
  show_legend = TRUE              # <-- NEW
) {
  rep_cols <- repcols_for_base(df, col_base)
  if (length(rep_cols) == 0) stop(sprintf("No replicate columns found for '%s_<n>'", col_base))

  df_lab <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      .mod_key = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_trim(.data[[mod_col]])),
      .label   = make_label(.mod_key, .data[[label_source_col]], control_label, delta_symbol)
    )

  long <- df_lab %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(gene_col, mod_col, label_source_col, predicted_col, ".label", ".mod_key", rep_cols))) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(rep_cols), names_to = "rep", values_to = "value") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(rep = as.integer(sub(".*_(\\d+)$", "\\1", rep))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(value))

  # --- MOD: use shared x_levels if provided ---
  if (is.null(x_levels)) {
    order_df <- df_lab %>%
      dplyr::distinct(.label, .mod_key, .data[[predicted_col]]) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.label, .mod_key) %>%
      dplyr::summarize(predicted_change = suppressWarnings(dplyr::first(na.omit(.data[[predicted_col]]))), .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(is_control = (.mod_key == "CONTROL"),
                    predicted_change = ifelse(is_control, NA_real_, predicted_change))
    non_ctrl <- order_df %>% dplyr::filter(!is_control) %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(predicted_change)) %>% dplyr::pull(.label)
    x_levels <- c(control_label, setdiff(non_ctrl, control_label))
  }

  long$._label_factor <- factor(long$.label, levels = x_levels)

  bar_df <- long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.label) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
                     ymax = max(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(df_lab %>% dplyr::distinct(.label, .mod_key), by = ".label")

  if (do_one_tailed_BH) {
    ptab <- compute_one_sided_bh_vs_control(long %>% dplyr::select(.label, value), control_label)
  } else {
    ctrl_vals <- long %>% dplyr::filter(tolower(.mod_key) == "control") %>% dplyr::pull(value)
    ptab <- long %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.label) %>%
      dplyr::summarize(
        pval = tryCatch({
          if (.label[1] == control_label || length(ctrl_vals) < 2 || dplyr::n() < 2) NA_real_
          else stats::t.test(value, ctrl_vals, var.equal = FALSE)$p.value
        }, error = function(e) NA_real_),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(padj = pval)
  }

  bar_df <- bar_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(ptab, by = ".label") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(sig = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(padj) ~ "",
      padj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      padj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      padj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ))

  panel_top <- 1.1*max(long$value, na.rm = TRUE)
  panel_range <- panel_top - 0
  base_star_y <- panel_top - 0.005 * panel_range
  set.seed(42)
  jitter_amt <- (runif(nrow(bar_df), min = -0.05, max = 0.05)) * panel_range
  bar_df$star_y <- pmin(panel_top - 0.002 * panel_range, base_star_y + jitter_amt)

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_col(
      data = bar_df,
      aes(x = .label, y = mean_val, fill = .mod_key),
      width = 0.7, color = NA
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = long,
      aes(x = ._label_factor, y = value),
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0),
      size = 0.9, alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = bar_df %>% dplyr::filter(sig != ""),
      aes(x = .label, y = star_y, label = sig),
      vjust = 1.1,
      size = star_size_mm
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "Modification",
      values = setNames(mod_colors[unique(bar_df$.mod_key)], unique(bar_df$.mod_key)),
      breaks = c("CONTROL", "UPREGULATION", "KNOCKOUT")
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_label) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = axis_text_size),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = legend_text_size),
      legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size),
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "right" else "none"   # <-- MOD: toggle legend
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, limits = x_levels) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = NA))) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "on")

  p
}

# --- MOD: heatmap accepts shared x_levels too ---
plot_single_rp_heatmap <- function(
  df, col_base,
  control_label = "Control",
  gene_col = "gene",
  mod_col  = "modification",
  label_source_col = "final_annotation_cult",
  rp_col = "recombinant_protein",
  predicted_col = "predicted_change",
  x_levels = NULL      # <-- NEW
) {
  rep_cols <- repcols_for_base(df, col_base)
  if (length(rep_cols) == 0) stop(sprintf("No replicate columns found for '%s_<n>'", col_base))

  df_lab <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      .mod_key = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_trim(.data[[mod_col]])),
      .label   = make_label(.mod_key, .data[[label_source_col]], control_label)
    )

  long <- df_lab %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(gene_col, mod_col, label_source_col, rp_col, predicted_col, ".label", ".mod_key", rep_cols))) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(rep_cols), names_to = "rep", values_to = "value") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(rp = .data[[rp_col]])

  agg <- long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.label, rp) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  ctrl_vals <- long %>% dplyr::filter(tolower(.mod_key) == "control") %>% dplyr::pull(value)
  ctrl_mean <- if (length(ctrl_vals)) mean(ctrl_vals, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
  max_val <- max(agg$mean_val, na.rm = TRUE); if (!is.finite(max_val)) max_val <- 1e-8
  if (!is.finite(ctrl_mean) || ctrl_mean < 0) ctrl_mean <- 0
  v_ctrl <- min(max(ctrl_mean / max_val, 0), 1)

  ptab <- compute_one_sided_bh_vs_control(long %>% dplyr::select(.label, value), control_label) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(sig = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(padj) ~ "",
      padj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      padj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      padj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ))
  stack_sig <- function(s) if (s == "") "" else paste(rep("*", nchar(s)), collapse = "\n")
  ptab$sig_stack <- vapply(ptab$sig, stack_sig, character(1))
  agg <- agg %>% dplyr::left_join(ptab %>% dplyr::select(.label, sig_stack), by = ".label")

  # --- MOD: use shared x_levels if provided; otherwise compute local
  if (is.null(x_levels)) {
    x_levels <- compute_x_levels(df, control_label, mod_col, label_source_col, predicted_col)
  }
  agg$.label <- factor(agg$.label, levels = x_levels)

  # colored x-ticks (same as before)
  label_mod_map <- df_lab %>% dplyr::distinct(.label, .mod_key)
  label_mod_map <- tibble::tibble(.label = x_levels) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(label_mod_map, by = ".label") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(.mod_key = dplyr::coalesce(.mod_key, "CONTROL"))

  axis_labels <- setNames(as.character(x_levels), x_levels)
  if (ggtext_available) {
    tick_color <- dplyr::case_when(
      label_mod_map$.mod_key == "UPREGULATION" ~ "#5ab4ac",
      label_mod_map$.mod_key == "KNOCKOUT"     ~ "#d8b365",
      TRUE                                      ~ "#000000"
    )
    # ensure arrow renders inside HTML spans
    x_levels_html <- x_levels
    axis_labels <- setNames(
      paste0("<span style='color:", tick_color, "'>", x_levels_html, "</span>"),
      x_levels
    )
  }


  heat_colors <- c("#ffffff", "#ece7f2", "#2b8cbe")
  heat_values <- sort(unique(c(0, v_ctrl, 1)))
  # Count stars per cell: "", "*", "**", "***" -> 0..3
agg <- agg %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    ptab %>%
      dplyr::select(.label, sig) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(n_stars = nchar(sig)),
    by = ".label"
  )

  # Split into up to three layers; each row gets nudged up/center/down
  stars_top    <- agg %>% dplyr::filter(n_stars >= 1)
  stars_middle <- agg %>% dplyr::filter(n_stars >= 2)
  stars_bottom <- agg %>% dplyr::filter(n_stars >= 3)
  
  star_size <- star_size_mm
  star_nudge <- 0.15  # adjust this to tighten/loosen (0.10–0.16 works well)
  
  p <- ggplot(agg, aes(x = .label, y = rp, fill = mean_val)) +
    geom_tile(color = NA) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = heat_colors,
      values = heat_values,
      limits = c(0, max_val),
      name = paste0("mean(", col_base, ")")
    ) +
    # draw stars top/center/bottom with small vertical nudge
    { if (nrow(stars_top))    geom_text(data = stars_top,    aes(label = "*"),
                                        position = position_nudge(y =  star_nudge),
                                        size = star_size) } +
    { if (nrow(stars_middle)) geom_text(data = stars_middle, aes(label = "*"),
                                        position = position_nudge(y =  0),
                                        size = star_size) } +
    { if (nrow(stars_bottom)) geom_text(data = stars_bottom, aes(label = "*"),
                                        position = position_nudge(y = -star_nudge),
                                        size = star_size) } +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = if (ggtext_available)
        ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = axis_text_size)
      else
        element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = axis_text_size),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = legend_text_size),
      legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = axis_labels, drop = FALSE, limits = x_levels) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0))
}

# =========================
# Build once with SHARED ORDER
# =========================
x_levels_shared <- compute_x_levels(
  HSA_overlap,
  control_label = "Control",
  mod_col = "modification",
  label_source_col = "final_annotation_cult",
  predicted_col = "predicted_change"
)

fig2a <- plot_bar_by_mod(
  HSA_overlap,
  col_base = "qp_mg_l_od_hr",
  y_label  = "q_p (mg/L/OD/hr)",
  do_one_tailed_BH = TRUE,
  x_levels = x_levels_shared,
  show_legend = TRUE    # keep legend on first barplot
)

fig2b <- plot_bar_by_mod(
  HSA_overlap,
  col_base = "od_48hr",
  y_label  = "Final Culture Density (OD)",
  do_one_tailed_BH = FALSE,
  x_levels = x_levels_shared,
  show_legend = FALSE   # <-- MOD: hide legend on second barplot
)

fig2c <- plot_single_rp_heatmap(
  HSA_overlap,
  col_base = "titer",
  x_levels = x_levels_shared
)
```

```{r}
all_data <- clean_names(AllStrainCultivationResults)

# --- 1. Compute per-row averages and build plot_data ---
plot_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    od_avg = rowMeans(select(., matches("^od_48hr_\\d+$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    qp_avg = rowMeans(select(., matches("^qp_mg_l_od_hr_\\d+$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    recombinant_protein = str_to_lower(recombinant_protein)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(od_avg), is.finite(qp_avg)) %>%
  mutate(

  )

# --- 2. Pre-compute Spearman rho and p-value per protein ---

  group_by(protein_label) %>%
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

mod_colors <- c(

  mutate(
    FC_avg = rowMeans(select(., matches("^FC_\\d+$")), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(FC_avg))

# --- 2. Reshape the four "*_predicted_change" columns in multimoleculeFSEOF
#         into long format, one row per gene x protein ---
fseof_long <- multimoleculeFSEOF %>%
  select(GQ_names, ends_with("_predicted_change")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_predicted_change"),
    names_to = "RecombinantProtein",
    names_pattern = "^(.*)_predicted_change$",
    values_to = "predicted_change"
  )

# match the RecombinantProtein values in AllStrainCultivationResults exactly
# (case-sensitive). Adjust the recode below if they don't.

# --- 3. Inner join: keeps only strains whose Gene has a matching entry
#         (GQ_names) in multimoleculeFSEOF for that specific protein ---
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  inner_join(
    fseof_long,
    by = c("Gene" = "GQ_names", "RecombinantProtein" = "RecombinantProtein")
  ) %>%
```

```{r}
# 1) Load & clean
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)

multimoleculeFSEOF <- readxl::read_excel(
  "figure_data/02 Round 2 - Multimolecule FSEOF/Multimolecule_FSEOF_Results.xlsx"
)

# Palette and ordering
protein_levels <- c("HSA", "RBDJ", "nb3B2", "Trastuzumab")
protein_colors <- c(
  HSA         = "#1b9e77",
  RBDJ        = "#d95f02",
  nb3B2       = "#7570b3",
  Trastuzumab = "#e7298a"
)

pred_cols <- c("HSA_predicted_change",
               "RBDJ_predicted_change",
               "nb3B2_predicted_change",
               "Trastuzumab_predicted_change")

df0 <- multimoleculeFSEOF

# Knockout flag (case-insensitive)
df1 <- df0 %>%
  mutate(is_knockout = str_detect(tolower(coalesce(category, "")), "knockout"))

# Sign-flip per-protein values for knockouts (NOT the original avg column)
df2 <- df1 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(pred_cols), ~ ifelse(is_knockout, -., .), .names = "{.col}_adj"))

adj_cols <- paste0(pred_cols, "_adj")

# Keep same subset as before, but compute sign-flipped average for plotting the bars
topN <- df2 %>%
  arrange(avg_predicted_change) %>%       # same selection criterion as your original code
  slice_head(n = 60) %>%
  mutate(
    GeneLabel    = FinalAnnotation,
    avg_flipped  = rowMeans(select(., all_of(adj_cols)), na.rm = TRUE)  # bar value
  )

# Establish a common GeneLabel order using the sign-flipped average
gene_order <- topN %>%
  arrange(avg_flipped) %>%
  pull(GeneLabel)

gene_order <- rev(gene_order)


# Long data for the points (per-protein, already sign-flipped in *_adj)
long_dat <- topN %>%
  select(GeneLabel, all_of(adj_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(adj_cols),
    names_to = "protein_adj",
    values_to = "predicted_change"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    protein   = str_remove(protein_adj, "_predicted_change_adj$"),
    protein   = factor(protein, levels = protein_levels),
    GeneLabel = factor(GeneLabel, levels = gene_order)
  )

# Data for single bars (sign-flipped average)
avg_dat <- topN %>%
  select(GeneLabel, avg_flipped) %>%
  mutate(GeneLabel = factor(GeneLabel, levels = gene_order))

# Plot: single avg (flipped) bar + per-protein points (flipped), aligned by common factor
set.seed(123)
fig3b <- ggplot(avg_dat, aes(x = GeneLabel, y = avg_flipped)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey50") +
  geom_col(fill = "grey85", width = 0.8) +
  geom_point(
    data = long_dat,
    aes(y = predicted_change, color = protein),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.18, height = 0),
    size = 1.9, alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Predicted change (bar = sign-flipped avg; points = sign-flipped per protein)",
    color = "Recombinant protein"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = 'none',
  ) +
```

##4.2. Fig3b.
```{r}
# Packages
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(clusterProfiler)

# -------------------------
# CONFIG (edit as needed)
# -------------------------
GO_file    <- "figure_data/goSLIMmod.gmt"
pred_cols  <- c("HSA_predicted_change",
                "RBDJ_predicted_change",
                "nb3B2_predicted_change",
                "Trastuzumab_predicted_change")
minGSSize  <- 5
maxGSSize  <- 5000
top_terms  <- 25
set.seed(1234)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Build avg_percentile per gene (Knockout rows sign-flip)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
df <- multimoleculeFSEOF %>%
  mutate(
    is_knockout = str_detect(tolower(coalesce(category, "")), "knockout")
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(pred_cols), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(across(
    all_of(pred_cols),
    ~ ifelse(is_knockout, -., .),
    .names = "{.col}_adj"
  ))

adj_cols <- paste0(pred_cols, "_adj")

# Percentiles per protein (0..100), then average across proteins
df_pct <- df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(adj_cols),
                ~ dplyr::percent_rank(.) * 100,
                .names = "{.col}_pct")) %>%
  mutate(
    avg_percentile = rowMeans(across(ends_with("_adj_pct")), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Prepare the ranked vector for GSEA (named numeric vector)
#    - keep one value per GQ_names (use max if duplicated)
#    - intersect with GMT genes
# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Read GMT (TERM2GENE)
gmt_df <- clusterProfiler::read.gmt(GO_file) %>%
  rename(term = term, gene = gene)

# Collapse duplicates by max percentile (you can switch to mean if preferred)
gene_scores <- df_pct %>%
  filter(!is.na(GQ_names), !is.na(avg_percentile)) %>%
  group_by(GQ_names) %>%
  summarise(avg_percentile = max(avg_percentile), .groups = "drop")

# Intersect with genes in GMT universe
universe <- intersect(gene_scores$GQ_names, unique(gmt_df$gene))
gene_scores <- gene_scores %>% filter(GQ_names %in% universe)

# Named numeric vector, sorted decreasing (required by GSEA)
geneList <- gene_scores$avg_percentile
names(geneList) <- gene_scores$GQ_names
geneList <- sort(geneList, decreasing = TRUE)

# --------------------------
# 3) Run GSEA with GMT sets
# --------------------------
gsea_res <- GSEA(
  geneList      = geneList,
  TERM2GENE     = gmt_df %>% select(term, gene),
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  minGSSize     = minGSSize,
  maxGSSize     = maxGSSize,
  verbose       = FALSE,
  seed          = TRUE
)

# Early exit if nothing enriched
if (is.null(gsea_res) || nrow(as.data.frame(gsea_res)) == 0) {
  message("No enriched terms found with current parameters.")
} else {
  res <- as.data.frame(gsea_res) %>%
    transmute(
      term_id      = ID,
      term_name    = Description,
      set_size_bg  = setSize,     # size inside the tested universe
      NES          = NES,
      pval         = pvalue,
      FDR          = p.adjust,
      core_enrich  = core_enrichment   # "/" separated leading-edge genes
    )

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 4) Compute each term's mean avg_percentile (x-axis)
  #    over all term genes present in the universe
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Map term -> all member genes (restricted to our universe)
  term2genes <- gmt_df %>%
    filter(gene %in% universe) %>%
    group_by(term) %>%
    summarise(genes = list(unique(gene)), .groups = "drop")

  # Quick look-up table: gene -> avg_percentile
  gene2pct <- tibble(
    GQ_names = names(geneList),
    avg_percentile = as.numeric(geneList)
  )

  res_aug <- res %>%
    left_join(term2genes, by = c("term_name" = "term")) %>%
    mutate(
      term_genes_present = map_int(genes, ~ sum(.x %in% gene2pct$GQ_names)),
      term_avg_percentile = map_dbl(
        genes,
        ~ gene2pct %>% filter(GQ_names %in% .x) %>%
            summarise(m = mean(avg_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
            pull(m) %>% { ifelse(length(.) == 0, NA_real_, .) }
      ),
      neglogFDR = -log10(FDR)
    ) %>%
    # pick top terms by FDR; then order by x for plotting
    arrange(FDR, desc(neglogFDR)) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_terms) %>%
    arrange(term_avg_percentile) %>%
    mutate(term_name = fct_inorder(term_name))

  # ----------------------
  # 5) Dotplot visualization
  # ----------------------
  fig3c <- ggplot(res_aug,
         aes(x = term_avg_percentile,
             y = term_name,
             size = term_genes_present,
             color = neglogFDR)) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(
      x = "Average percentile score of gene set",
      y = NULL,
      size = "# genes in set",
      color = expression(-log[10](FDR)),
      title = "GSEA on GO-SLIM (rank: avg_percentile)",
      subtitle = paste0("Universe: ", length(universe), " genes; Showing top ", top_terms)
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12)+ 
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#400045", high = "#d8b365")
}
fig3c
ggsave('Fig3c.svg', fig3c, width = 4.5, height = 2.5, units = "in")
```

##4.3. Fig 3c.
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(purrr)
  library(patchwork)
})

# ---------------------------
# Inputs you may tweak
# ---------------------------
fc_columns <- c("FC_1", "FC_2", "FC_3")
od_columns <- c("OD_48hr_1", "OD_48hr_2", "OD_48hr_3")

rp_order <- c("Trastuzumab", "HSA", "RBDJ", "nb3B2")  # (5)
control_label <- "Control"

# ---------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------
map_modification <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c("Upregulation", "Mixed, Upregulation") ~ "Upregulation",
    x %in% c("Knockout", "Mixed, Knockout")         ~ "Knockout",
    TRUE                                            ~ x
  )
}

make_label <- function(mod_key, label_src, control_label = "Control", delta_symbol = "\u0394") {
  dplyr::case_when(
    mod_key == "CONTROL"      ~ control_label,
    mod_key == "UPREGULATION" ~ paste0(label_src),
    mod_key == "KNOCKOUT"     ~ paste0(label_src),
    TRUE ~ label_src
  )
}

repcols_for_base <- function(df, base_vec) {
  # Allow explicit vector of columns or a base name pattern
  if (length(base_vec) == 1 && !base_vec %in% names(df)) {
    grep(paste0("^", base_vec, "_\\d+$"), names(df), value = TRUE)
  } else {
    base_vec
  }
}

# BH-adjusted Welch t-tests vs Control, within each RP
# 1) Remove any stale versions from your session
suppressWarnings(rm(compute_stats_vs_control))
suppressWarnings(rm(prepare_heatmap_data))

# 2) Re-define the helpers (no `.label` anywhere)

# ---------- Robust stats helper (no .label anywhere) ----------
compute_stats_vs_control <- function(df_long, control_label, test_side = c("greater","two.sided")) {
  side <- match.arg(test_side)

  # Short-circuit: if df_long is empty, return empty tibble with right columns
  if (nrow(df_long) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(RecombinantProtein=character(), FinalAnnotation_label=character(), sig=character()))
  }

  df_long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(RecombinantProtein) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(function(d, key) {
      # controls (may be 0-length; then we can't test)
      ctrl_vals <- d %>%
        dplyr::filter(FinalAnnotation_label == control_label) %>%
        dplyr::pull(value) %>%
        stats::na.omit()

      tbl <- d %>%
        dplyr::group_by(FinalAnnotation_label) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(vals = list(stats::na.omit(value)), .groups = "drop") %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          pval = purrr::map2_dbl(vals, FinalAnnotation_label, ~{
            if (.y == control_label || length(ctrl_vals) < 2 || length(.x) < 2) return(NA_real_)
            tryCatch(
              stats::t.test(.x, ctrl_vals, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = side)$p.value,
              error = function(e) NA_real_
            )
          })
        )

      non_ctrl <- !is.na(tbl$pval) & tbl$FinalAnnotation_label != control_label
      tbl$FDR <- NA_real_
      if (any(non_ctrl)) tbl$FDR[non_ctrl] <- p.adjust(tbl$pval[non_ctrl], method = "BH")

      tbl %>%
        dplyr::mutate(sig = dplyr::case_when(
          is.na(FDR)  ~ "",
          FDR < 0.001 ~ "***",
          FDR < 0.01  ~ "**",
          FDR < 0.05  ~ "*",
          TRUE        ~ ""
        )) %>%
        dplyr::select(FinalAnnotation_label, sig)
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(RecombinantProtein, FinalAnnotation_label, sig)
}

# ---------- Hardened data prep (guards + clear errors) ----------
# returns a list: list(agg=<data>, x_levels=<char>, axis_label_colors=<named char>)
prepare_heatmap_data <- function(cultivation_data, feature_data, value_columns,
                                 test_side, control_label) {
  map_modification <- function(x) dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c("Upregulation", "Mixed, Upregulation") ~ "Upregulation",
    x %in% c("Knockout", "Mixed, Knockout")         ~ "Knockout",
    TRUE                                            ~ x
  )
  make_label <- function(mod_key, label_src, control_label = "Control", delta_symbol = "\u0394") {
    up_arrow <- "↑"; Encoding(up_arrow) <- "UTF-8"
    dplyr::case_when(
      mod_key == "CONTROL"      ~ control_label,
      mod_key == "UPREGULATION" ~ paste0(label_src),
      mod_key == "KNOCKOUT"     ~ paste0(label_src),
      TRUE ~ label_src
    )
  }

  # map + join to bring in FinalAnnotation + avg_predicted_change
  feat_mapped <- feature_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Modification_mapped = map_modification(category)) %>%
    dplyr::select(GQ_names, Modification_mapped, FinalAnnotation, avg_predicted_change)

  merged <- cultivation_data %>%
    dplyr::select(-FinalAnnotation) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      feat_mapped,
      by = c("Gene" = "GQ_names", "Modification" = "Modification_mapped")
    )

  # label building (keep annotated rows OR Control)
  df_lab0 <- merged %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(FinalAnnotation) | Modification == control_label) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      mod_key = toupper(trimws(Modification)),
      FinalAnnotation_label = make_label(mod_key, FinalAnnotation, control_label)
    )

  # ---------- (1) Prefilter: keep only genes with data for ALL 4 RPs ----------
  # Use the replicate columns you are plotting; require at least one non-NA per (RP, label)
  rep_cols <- value_columns
  complete_labels <- df_lab0 %>%
    dplyr::filter(mod_key != "CONTROL", !is.na(FinalAnnotation)) %>%        # evaluate on non-controls
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(has_any = any(!is.na(c_across(all_of(rep_cols))))) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::filter(has_any) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(FinalAnnotation_label, RecombinantProtein) %>%
    dplyr::add_count(FinalAnnotation_label, name = "rp_count") %>%
    dplyr::filter(rp_count >= 4) %>%                                        # must have all 4 RPs
    dplyr::pull(FinalAnnotation_label) %>% unique()

  df_lab <- df_lab0 %>%
    dplyr::filter(FinalAnnotation_label %in% complete_labels | mod_key == "CONTROL")

  # Long layout
  long <- df_lab %>%
    dplyr::select(RecombinantProtein, FinalAnnotation_label, mod_key, dplyr::all_of(rep_cols)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(rep_cols), names_to = "rep", values_to = "value") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(value))

  # Means per cell
  means <- long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(RecombinantProtein, FinalAnnotation_label) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # Stats vs control (within RP)
  stats <- compute_stats_vs_control(
    df_long       = long,
    control_label = control_label,
    test_side     = test_side
  )

  agg <- means %>%
    dplyr::left_join(stats, by = c("RecombinantProtein","FinalAnnotation_label")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(sig = dplyr::coalesce(sig, ""), n_stars = nchar(sig))

  # ---------- (6) X-order: Control first, then ascending avg_predicted_change ----------
  x_order_tbl <- df_lab %>%
    dplyr::distinct(FinalAnnotation_label, mod_key, avg_predicted_change) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(FinalAnnotation_label, mod_key) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(avg_predicted_change = suppressWarnings(dplyr::first(na.omit(avg_predicted_change))), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(avg_predicted_change = ifelse(mod_key == "CONTROL", NA_real_, avg_predicted_change))

  non_ctrl_x <- x_order_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(mod_key != "CONTROL") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(avg_predicted_change) %>%
    dplyr::pull(FinalAnnotation_label)

  x_levels <- c(control_label, setdiff(non_ctrl_x, control_label))
  agg$FinalAnnotation_label <- factor(agg$FinalAnnotation_label, levels = x_levels)

  # ---------- (5) RP order ----------
  rp_order <- c("Trastuzumab", "HSA", "RBDJ", "nb3B2")
  agg$RecombinantProtein <- factor(agg$RecombinantProtein, levels = rp_order)

  # ---------- (4) Build tick-label colors by modification ----------
  # Same scheme as your earlier figure: Upreg=#5ab4ac, KO=#d8b365, Control=black
  label_mod_map <- df_lab %>% dplyr::distinct(FinalAnnotation_label, mod_key)
  axis_label_colors <- setNames(
    dplyr::case_when(
      label_mod_map$mod_key == "UPREGULATION" ~ "#5ab4ac",
      label_mod_map$mod_key == "KNOCKOUT"     ~ "#d8b365",
      TRUE                                     ~ "#000000"
    ),
    label_mod_map$FinalAnnotation_label
  )

  list(agg = agg, x_levels = x_levels, axis_label_colors = axis_label_colors)
}



# Draw heatmap with stacked stars and custom anchors
# REPLACE your current plot_sig_heatmap() with this version
# Drop-in replacement for plot_sig_heatmap()
plot_sig_heatmap <- function(agg, fill_name, anchor_vals, anchor_cols,
                             x_levels = NULL, axis_label_colors = NULL) {
  stopifnot(length(anchor_vals) == length(anchor_cols))
  ggtext_available <- requireNamespace("ggtext", quietly = TRUE)

  # --- detect x column ---
  x_col <- if ("FinalAnnotation_label" %in% names(agg)) "FinalAnnotation_label" else
           if ("Gene_label" %in% names(agg))            "Gene_label"            else
           stop("plot_sig_heatmap(): expected a column named FinalAnnotation_label or Gene_label")

  # apply x_levels if provided
  if (!is.null(x_levels)) {
    agg[[x_col]] <- factor(agg[[x_col]], levels = x_levels)
  }

  max_val <- max(agg$mean_val, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(max_val) || max_val <= 0) max_val <- 1e-8

  vals <- pmax(pmin(anchor_vals / max_val, 1), 0)
  vals <- sort(unique(vals))

  # build centered multi-line star labels safely
  stars_df <- agg %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_stars_san = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(n_stars) ~ 0L, n_stars < 0 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ as.integer(round(n_stars))
      ),
      n_stars_san = pmin(3L, n_stars_san),
      sig_stack = vapply(n_stars_san, function(k) if (k <= 0L) "" else paste(rep("*", k), collapse = "\n"),
                         FUN.VALUE = character(1))
    )

  star_size       <- 10/2.845
  star_lineheight <- 0.4

  # colored x tick labels (if provided)
  labels_arg <- waiver()
  if (!is.null(axis_label_colors) && ggtext_available) {
    levs <- levels(agg[[x_col]])
    # if not factored yet, derive levels from unique order
    if (is.null(levs)) levs <- unique(agg[[x_col]])
    lbls <- as.character(levs)
    lbls_html <- lbls
    cols <- axis_label_colors[levs]; cols[is.na(cols)] <- "#000000"
    labels_arg <- setNames(
      paste0("<span style='color:", cols, "'>", lbls_html, "</span>"),
      levs
    )
  }

  ggplot(agg, aes(x = .data[[x_col]], y = RecombinantProtein, fill = mean_val)) +
    geom_tile(color = NA) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = anchor_cols, values = vals, limits = c(0, max_val), name = fill_name) +
    geom_text(
      data = stars_df %>% dplyr::filter(sig_stack != ""),
      aes(x = .data[[x_col]], label = sig_stack),
      hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5,
      lineheight = star_lineheight,
      size = star_size
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = if (!is.null(axis_label_colors) && ggtext_available)
        ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 10)
      else
        element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank()
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = labels_arg, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE)
}




# ---------------------------
# Build FC heatmap (1), (2), (3)

# FC
fc_prep <- prepare_heatmap_data(
  AllStrainCultivationResults, multimoleculeFSEOF, fc_columns, "greater", control_label

# OD — (2) darker blues for mean/max to enhance contrast below mean
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)

})

# Read data
multimoleculeFSEOF <- readxl::read_excel(
  "figure_data/02 Round 2 - Multimolecule FSEOF/Multimolecule_FSEOF_Results.xlsx"
)

# ---------------------------
# Inputs
# ---------------------------
fc_columns <- c("FC_1", "FC_2", "FC_3")
od_columns <- c("OD_48hr_1", "OD_48hr_2", "OD_48hr_3")
rp_order <- c("Trastuzumab", "HSA", "RBDJ", "nb3B2")
control_label <- "Control"

# Barplot colors
protein_levels <- c("HSA", "RBDJ", "nb3B2", "Trastuzumab")
protein_colors <- c(
  HSA         = "#1b9e77",
  RBDJ        = "#d95f02",
  nb3B2       = "#7570b3",
  Trastuzumab = "#e7298a"
)

# ---------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------
map_modification <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c("Upregulation", "Mixed, Upregulation") ~ "Upregulation",
    x %in% c("Knockout", "Mixed, Knockout")         ~ "Knockout",
    TRUE                                            ~ x
  )
}

make_label <- function(mod_key, label_src, control_label = "Control", delta_symbol = "\u0394") {
  dplyr::case_when(
    mod_key == "CONTROL"      ~ control_label,
    mod_key == "UPREGULATION" ~ paste0(label_src),
    mod_key == "KNOCKOUT"     ~ paste0(label_src),
    TRUE ~ label_src
  )
}

compute_stats_vs_control <- function(df_long, control_label, test_side = c("greater","two.sided")) {
  side <- match.arg(test_side)
  if (nrow(df_long) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(RecombinantProtein=character(), FinalAnnotation_label=character(), sig=character()))
  }
  
  df_long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(RecombinantProtein) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(function(d, key) {
      ctrl_vals <- d %>%
        dplyr::filter(FinalAnnotation_label == control_label) %>%
        dplyr::pull(value) %>%
        stats::na.omit()
      
      tbl <- d %>%
        dplyr::group_by(FinalAnnotation_label) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(vals = list(stats::na.omit(value)), .groups = "drop") %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          pval = purrr::map2_dbl(vals, FinalAnnotation_label, ~{
            if (.y == control_label || length(ctrl_vals) < 2 || length(.x) < 2) return(NA_real_)
            tryCatch(
              stats::t.test(.x, ctrl_vals, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = side)$p.value,
              error = function(e) NA_real_
            )
          })
        )
      
      non_ctrl <- !is.na(tbl$pval) & tbl$FinalAnnotation_label != control_label
      tbl$FDR <- NA_real_
      if (any(non_ctrl)) tbl$FDR[non_ctrl] <- p.adjust(tbl$pval[non_ctrl], method = "BH")
      
      tbl %>%
        dplyr::mutate(sig = dplyr::case_when(
          is.na(FDR)  ~ "",
          FDR < 0.001 ~ "***",
          FDR < 0.01  ~ "**",
          FDR < 0.05  ~ "*",
          TRUE        ~ ""
        )) %>%
        dplyr::select(FinalAnnotation_label, sig)
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(RecombinantProtein, FinalAnnotation_label, sig)
}

prepare_heatmap_data <- function(cultivation_data, feature_data, value_columns,
                                 test_side, control_label) {
  map_modification <- function(x) dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c("Upregulation", "Mixed, Upregulation") ~ "Upregulation",
    x %in% c("Knockout", "Mixed, Knockout")         ~ "Knockout",
    TRUE                                            ~ x
  )
  make_label <- function(mod_key, label_src, control_label = "Control", delta_symbol = "\u0394") {
    up_arrow <- "↑"; Encoding(up_arrow) <- "UTF-8"
    dplyr::case_when(
      mod_key == "CONTROL"      ~ control_label,
      mod_key == "UPREGULATION" ~ paste0(label_src),
      mod_key == "KNOCKOUT"     ~ paste0(label_src),
      TRUE ~ label_src
    )
  }
  
  feat_mapped <- feature_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Modification_mapped = map_modification(category)) %>%
    dplyr::select(GQ_names, Modification_mapped, FinalAnnotation, avg_predicted_change)
  
  merged <- cultivation_data %>%
    dplyr::select(-FinalAnnotation) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      feat_mapped,
      by = c("Gene" = "GQ_names", "Modification" = "Modification_mapped")
    )
  
  df_lab0 <- merged %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(FinalAnnotation) | Modification == control_label) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      mod_key = toupper(trimws(Modification)),
      FinalAnnotation_label = make_label(mod_key, FinalAnnotation, control_label)
    )
  
  rep_cols <- value_columns
  complete_labels <- df_lab0 %>%
    dplyr::filter(mod_key != "CONTROL", !is.na(FinalAnnotation)) %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(has_any = any(!is.na(c_across(all_of(rep_cols))))) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::filter(has_any) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(FinalAnnotation_label, RecombinantProtein) %>%
    dplyr::add_count(FinalAnnotation_label, name = "rp_count") %>%
    dplyr::filter(rp_count >= 4) %>%
    dplyr::pull(FinalAnnotation_label) %>% unique()
  
  df_lab <- df_lab0 %>%
    dplyr::filter(FinalAnnotation_label %in% complete_labels | mod_key == "CONTROL")
  
  long <- df_lab %>%
    dplyr::select(RecombinantProtein, FinalAnnotation_label, mod_key, dplyr::all_of(rep_cols)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(rep_cols), names_to = "rep", values_to = "value") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(value))
  
  means <- long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(RecombinantProtein, FinalAnnotation_label) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  stats <- compute_stats_vs_control(
    df_long       = long,
    control_label = control_label,
    test_side     = test_side
  )
  
  agg <- means %>%
    dplyr::left_join(stats, by = c("RecombinantProtein","FinalAnnotation_label")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(sig = dplyr::coalesce(sig, ""), n_stars = nchar(sig))
  
  x_order_tbl <- df_lab %>%
    dplyr::distinct(FinalAnnotation_label, mod_key, avg_predicted_change) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(FinalAnnotation_label, mod_key) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(avg_predicted_change = suppressWarnings(dplyr::first(na.omit(avg_predicted_change))), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(avg_predicted_change = ifelse(mod_key == "CONTROL", NA_real_, avg_predicted_change))
  
  non_ctrl_x <- x_order_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(mod_key != "CONTROL") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(avg_predicted_change) %>%
    dplyr::pull(FinalAnnotation_label)
  
  x_levels <- c(control_label, setdiff(non_ctrl_x, control_label))
  agg$FinalAnnotation_label <- factor(agg$FinalAnnotation_label, levels = x_levels)
  agg$RecombinantProtein <- factor(agg$RecombinantProtein, levels = rp_order)
  
  label_mod_map <- df_lab %>% dplyr::distinct(FinalAnnotation_label, mod_key)
  axis_label_colors <- setNames(
    dplyr::case_when(
      label_mod_map$mod_key == "UPREGULATION" ~ "#5ab4ac",
      label_mod_map$mod_key == "KNOCKOUT"     ~ "#d8b365",
      TRUE                                     ~ "#000000"
    ),
    label_mod_map$FinalAnnotation_label
  )
  
  list(agg = agg, x_levels = x_levels, axis_label_colors = axis_label_colors)
}

plot_sig_heatmap <- function(agg, fill_name, anchor_vals, anchor_cols,
                             x_levels = NULL, axis_label_colors = NULL) {
  stopifnot(length(anchor_vals) == length(anchor_cols))
  ggtext_available <- requireNamespace("ggtext", quietly = TRUE)
  
  x_col <- if ("FinalAnnotation_label" %in% names(agg)) "FinalAnnotation_label" else
           if ("Gene_label" %in% names(agg))            "Gene_label"            else
           stop("plot_sig_heatmap(): expected a column named FinalAnnotation_label or Gene_label")
  
  if (!is.null(x_levels)) {
    agg[[x_col]] <- factor(agg[[x_col]], levels = x_levels)
  }
  
  max_val <- max(agg$mean_val, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(max_val) || max_val <= 0) max_val <- 1e-8
  
  vals <- pmax(pmin(anchor_vals / max_val, 1), 0)
  vals <- sort(unique(vals))
  
  stars_df <- agg %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_stars_san = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(n_stars) ~ 0L, n_stars < 0 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ as.integer(round(n_stars))
      ),
      n_stars_san = pmin(3L, n_stars_san),
      sig_stack = vapply(n_stars_san, function(k) if (k <= 0L) "" else paste(rep("*", k), collapse = "\n"),
                         FUN.VALUE = character(1))
    )
  
  star_size       <- 10/2.845
  star_lineheight <- 0.4
  
  labels_arg <- waiver()
  if (!is.null(axis_label_colors) && ggtext_available) {
    levs <- levels(agg[[x_col]])
    if (is.null(levs)) levs <- unique(agg[[x_col]])
    lbls <- as.character(levs)
    lbls_html <- lbls
    cols <- axis_label_colors[levs]; cols[is.na(cols)] <- "#000000"
    labels_arg <- setNames(
      paste0("<span style='color:", cols, "'>", lbls_html, "</span>"),
      levs
    )
  }
  
  ggplot(agg, aes(x = .data[[x_col]], y = RecombinantProtein, fill = mean_val)) +
    geom_tile(color = NA) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = anchor_cols, values = vals, limits = c(0, max_val), name = fill_name) +
    geom_text(
      data = stars_df %>% dplyr::filter(sig_stack != ""),
      aes(x = .data[[x_col]], label = sig_stack),
      hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5,
      lineheight = star_lineheight,
      size = star_size
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = if (!is.null(axis_label_colors) && ggtext_available)
        ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 10)
      else
        element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank()
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = labels_arg, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE)
}

df_bar <- multimoleculeFSEOF %>%
```

```{r}
               "nb3B2_predicted_change", "Trastuzumab_predicted_change")

                         Inhibitor = "#d95f02",

shared_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 12) +

    ggside.panel.scale.x    = 0.05,
    ggside.panel.scale.y    = 0.05,

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1.  GENE-LEVEL LOOKUP  (shared by both plots)

gene_lookup <- multimoleculeFSEOF %>%
  mutate(
    GQ_names        = str_trim(as.character(GQ_names)),

  ) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(pred_cols), as.numeric)) %>%

                ~ ifelse(is_knockout, -., .),
                .names = "{.col}_adj")) %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with("_adj"),
                ~ dplyr::percent_rank(.) * 100,
                .names = "{.col}_adj_pct")) %>%
  transmute(
    GQ_names,
    FinalAnnotation,
    avg_percentile = rowMeans(across(ends_with("_adj_pct")), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

lk_GQ <- gene_lookup %>% select(GQ_names, FinalAnnotation, avg_percentile)
lk_FA  <- gene_lookup %>%

    Interaction = str_trim(as.character(Interaction))

  mutate(Rank_Pred_change = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Rank_Pred_change))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Transcription Factor`), !is.na(Gene)) %>%
  distinct(`Transcription Factor`, Gene, Interaction, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  left_join(lk_GQ, by = c("Gene" = "GQ_names")) %>%
  rename(FA_byGQ = FinalAnnotation) %>%
  left_join(lk_FA, by = c("Gene" = "FinalAnnotation")) %>%
  mutate(
    avg_percentile  = coalesce(avg_percentile, avg_percentile_byFA),
    FinalAnnotation = coalesce(FA_byGQ, Gene)
  ) %>%
  select(-FA_byGQ, -avg_percentile_byFA)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3.  HELPERS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
collapse_interaction <- function(x) {
  u <- unique(na.omit(x))
  if (length(u) == 1) str_to_title(u) else "Mixed"
}

add_plot_cols <- function(df, label_col, match_vec) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      label       = ifelse(.data[[label_col]] %in% match_vec, .data[[label_col]], ""),
      has_label   = label != "",
      color_var   = ifelse(has_label, "black", as.character(Interaction)),
      Interaction = factor(Interaction, levels = names(interaction_palette))
    ) %>%
    # ③ sort so labelled points are drawn last → rendered on top
    arrange(has_label)
}

tested_tf_lookup <- AllStrainCultivationResults %>%
  mutate(FA_upper = toupper(as.character(FinalAnnotation))) %>%
  pull(FA_upper) %>% unique()

tf_summary1 <- tf_edges_joined %>%
  group_by(`Transcription Factor`) %>%
  summarise(
    genes_influenced      = n_distinct(FinalAnnotation[!is.na(avg_percentile)]),
    median_avg_percentile = median(avg_percentile[!is.na(avg_percentile)], na.rm = TRUE),
    max_avg_percentile    = max(avg_percentile[!is.na(avg_percentile)],    na.rm = TRUE),
    Interaction           = collapse_interaction(Interaction),

  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(median_avg_percentile), is.finite(median_avg_percentile),

  mutate(TF_trim_upper = toupper(str_sub(`Transcription Factor`, 1, -2))) %>%

fc_lookup <- AllStrainCultivationResults %>%

  group_by(FinalAnnotation, Modification) %>%
  summarise(Median_Avg_FC = mean(Avg_FC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Median_Avg_FC)) %>%
  mutate(Interaction = case_when(
    Modification == "Upregulation" ~ "Activator",

  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Interaction)) %>%
  transmute(Gene = FinalAnnotation, Interaction, Median_Avg_FC)

tf_summary2 <- tf_edges_joined %>%
  left_join(fc_lookup, by = c("Gene", "Interaction")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Median_Avg_FC)) %>%
  group_by(`Transcription Factor`) %>%

    NumTargets        = n(),

  add_plot_cols("TF_clean", annotate_tfs)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5.  SHARED SCALE / LAYER DEFINITIONS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
present_levels <- intersect(
  names(interaction_palette),
  union(levels(tf_summary1$Interaction), levels(tf_summary2$Interaction))
)
fill_vals <- interaction_palette[present_levels]

# ② geom_point is NOT in shared_layers → size can be added per-plot without
#    leaking into the histogram geoms and without triggering the warning.
#    ③ Two point layers per plot: unlabelled first, labelled on top.
point_layers <- function(size_var = NULL, fixed_size = 2) {
  make_aes <- function() {
    if (!is.null(size_var))
      aes(color = color_var, fill = Interaction, shape = has_label,
          size = .data[[size_var]])
    else
      aes(color = color_var, fill = Interaction, shape = has_label)
  }
  # 3. size only passed to geom_point when using size_var; otherwise use fixed_size
  list(
    geom_point(data = ~ filter(., !has_label), mapping = make_aes(),
               stroke = 1, alpha = 0.85,
               size = if (is.null(size_var)) fixed_size else NULL),
    geom_point(data = ~ filter(., has_label),  mapping = make_aes(),
               stroke = 1, alpha = 0.85,
               size = if (is.null(size_var)) fixed_size else NULL)
  )
}

shared_layers <- list(
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = label),
    size = 3, color = "black",
    max.overlaps  = Inf,
    point.padding = 0.5, box.padding = 0.5,
    segment.size  = 0.4, segment.colour = "black",
    arrow = grid::arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.025, "npc"))
  ),
  scale_color_manual(values = c(fill_vals, "black" = "black"), guide = "none"),
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_vals, breaks = present_levels, name = "Interaction"),
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 16, "TRUE" = 21), guide = "none"),
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 1))),
  geom_xsidehistogram(bins = 20, fill = "grey60", color = NA, linewidth = 0),
  geom_ysidehistogram(bins = 20, fill = "grey60", color = NA, linewidth = 0),
  shared_theme
)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

p1 <- ggplot(tf_summary1, aes(x = max_avg_percentile, y = genes_influenced)) +
  point_layers("median_avg_percentile") +
  shared_layers +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_vals, breaks = present_levels, guide = "none") +  # suppress fill legend in p1

  labs(x = "Maximum Average Target Percentile",
       y = "Number of FSEOF Gene Targets")
# 2. Increase point size in p2 by adding a fixed size in point_layers()
p2 <- ggplot(tf_summary2, aes(x = Avg_Median_Avg_FC, y = NumTargets)) +
  point_layers(fixed_size = 4) +   # <-- pass a fixed size
  shared_layers +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(1)) +   # 4. integer y axis
  labs(x = "Avg Median FC Across Matched Targets",
       y = "Number of Matched Targets")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 7.  COMBINE & SAVE

Fig4 <- (p1 | p2) +

Fig4
```

##5.2 Fig 4b. 
```{r}
# TF-only prep: filter {TF Upregulation, Control}, build labels "TF: <FinalAnnotation>",
# compute per-cell means and BH/FDR stars, build x-order and tick colors.
prepare_tf_heatmap_data <- function(cultivation_data,
                                    value_columns,
                                    control_label = "Control",
                                    feature_data = NULL   # optional: to order by avg_predicted_change
) {
  ggtext_available <- requireNamespace("ggtext", quietly = TRUE)

  # 1) Filter the subset
  df0 <- cultivation_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(Modification %in% c("TF Upregulation", control_label))

  # 2) Labels (Control, TF: <FinalAnnotation>)
  df_lab <- df0 %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      mod_key = dplyr::case_when(
        Modification == "TF Upregulation" ~ "TF_UPREG",
        Modification == control_label      ~ "CONTROL",
        TRUE ~ toupper(Modification)
      ),
      FinalAnnotation_label = dplyr::case_when(
        mod_key == "CONTROL"   ~ control_label,
        mod_key == "TF_UPREG"  ~ paste0("TF: ", FinalAnnotation),
        TRUE ~ FinalAnnotation
      )
    )

  # 3) Long with replicates
  stopifnot(all(value_columns %in% names(df_lab)))
  long <- df_lab %>%
    dplyr::select(RecombinantProtein, FinalAnnotation_label, mod_key, dplyr::all_of(value_columns)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(value_columns), names_to = "rep", values_to = "value") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(value))

  # 4) Means per (RP, label)
  means <- long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(RecombinantProtein, FinalAnnotation_label) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # 5) Stats vs Control (reuse your existing helper)
  # NOTE: For FC, you'll call this prep and then plot with test_side="greater";
  # for OD, call prep and plot with test_side="two.sided".
  compute_stats <- function(test_side) {
    compute_stats_vs_control(
      df_long       = long,
      control_label = control_label,
      test_side     = test_side
    )
  }

  # Return a function to join stats later (lets us reuse a single prep for FC & OD)
  join_stats <- function(test_side) {
    means %>%
      dplyr::left_join(compute_stats(test_side), by = c("RecombinantProtein", "FinalAnnotation_label")) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(sig = dplyr::coalesce(sig, ""), n_stars = nchar(sig))
  }

  # 6) X-order: Control first, then (optionally) by avg_predicted_change if provided
  if (!is.null(feature_data) && all(c("GQ_names", "category", "FinalAnnotation", "avg_predicted_change") %in% names(feature_data))) {
    # Map feature_data to TF Upreg + Control domain
    feat_tf <- feature_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(category == "TF Upregulation") %>%
      dplyr::distinct(FinalAnnotation, avg_predicted_change)

    x_order_tbl <- df_lab %>%
      dplyr::distinct(FinalAnnotation_label, mod_key, FinalAnnotation) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(feat_tf, by = "FinalAnnotation") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(avg_predicted_change = dplyr::if_else(mod_key == "CONTROL", NA_real_, avg_predicted_change))

    non_ctrl_x <- x_order_tbl %>%
      dplyr::filter(mod_key != "CONTROL") %>%
      dplyr::arrange(avg_predicted_change) %>%
      dplyr::pull(FinalAnnotation_label)
  } else {
    # Fallback: alphabetical (or keep current order) for TF labels
    non_ctrl_x <- df_lab %>%
      dplyr::filter(mod_key != "CONTROL") %>%
      dplyr::pull(FinalAnnotation_label) %>% unique() %>% sort()
  }
  x_levels <- c(control_label, setdiff(non_ctrl_x, control_label))

  # 7) RP order
  rp_order <- c("Trastuzumab", "HSA", "RBDJ", "nb3B2")

  # 8) x-tick colors: Control black, TF upreg brown
  # (These feed to plot_sig_heatmap as axis_label_colors)
  label_mod_map <- df_lab %>% dplyr::distinct(FinalAnnotation_label, mod_key)
  axis_label_colors <- setNames(
    dplyr::case_when(
      label_mod_map$mod_key == "TF_UPREG" ~ "#8c510a",  # brown
      TRUE                                 ~ "#000000"  # control or anything else
    ),
    label_mod_map$FinalAnnotation_label
  )

  list(
    long      = long,
    means     = means,    # not strictly needed outside
    join_stats = join_stats,
    x_levels  = x_levels,
    rp_order  = rp_order,
    axis_label_colors = axis_label_colors
  )
}

# Columns
fc_columns <- c("FC_1", "FC_2", "FC_3")
od_columns <- c("OD_48hr_1", "OD_48hr_2", "OD_48hr_3")
control_label <- "Control"

# --- Prep once for FC subset (TF Upreg + Control)
tf_fc_prep <- prepare_tf_heatmap_data(
  cultivation_data = AllStrainCultivationResults,
  value_columns    = fc_columns,
  control_label    = control_label,
  feature_data     = multimoleculeFSEOF   # pass if you want x-order by avg_predicted_change; else set NULL
)

# Aggregate with stats (FC: one-tailed, greater)
tf_fc_agg <- tf_fc_prep$join_stats(test_side = "greater") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FinalAnnotation_label = factor(FinalAnnotation_label, levels = tf_fc_prep$x_levels),
    RecombinantProtein    = factor(RecombinantProtein, levels = tf_fc_prep$rp_order)
  )

# FC color anchors: 0 -> white, 1 -> "#ffffe5", max -> "#005a32"
fc_anchor_vals <- c(0, 1, max(tf_fc_agg$mean_val, na.rm = TRUE))
fc_anchor_cols <- c("#ffffff", "#ffffe5", "#005a32")

tf_fc_plot <- plot_sig_heatmap(
  agg        = tf_fc_agg,
  fill_name  = "mean(FC)",
  anchor_vals = fc_anchor_vals,
  anchor_cols = fc_anchor_cols,
  x_levels  = tf_fc_prep$x_levels,
  axis_label_colors = tf_fc_prep$axis_label_colors
)

# --- Prep once for OD subset (TF Upreg + Control)
tf_od_prep <- prepare_tf_heatmap_data(
  cultivation_data = AllStrainCultivationResults,
  value_columns    = od_columns,
  control_label    = control_label,
  feature_data     = multimoleculeFSEOF
)

# Aggregate with stats (OD: two-tailed)
tf_od_agg <- tf_od_prep$join_stats(test_side = "two.sided") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FinalAnnotation_label = factor(FinalAnnotation_label, levels = tf_od_prep$x_levels),
    RecombinantProtein    = factor(RecombinantProtein, levels = tf_od_prep$rp_order)
  )

# OD anchors: 0 -> white, mean(Control) -> darker mid blue, max -> darkest blue
ctrl_od_vals <- AllStrainCultivationResults %>%
  dplyr::filter(Modification == control_label) %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(od_columns)) %>%
  as.matrix() %>% as.numeric() %>% stats::na.omit()
ctrl_od_mean <- if (length(ctrl_od_vals)) mean(ctrl_od_vals) else 0

od_anchor_vals <- c(min(tf_od_agg$mean_val, na.rm = TRUE), ctrl_od_mean, max(tf_od_agg$mean_val, na.rm = TRUE))
od_anchor_cols <- c("#ffffff", "#a6bddb", "#2b8cbe")  # darker mid & max blues

tf_od_plot <- plot_sig_heatmap(
  agg        = tf_od_agg,
  fill_name  = "mean(OD 48h)",
  anchor_vals = od_anchor_vals,
  anchor_cols = od_anchor_cols,
  x_levels  = tf_od_prep$x_levels,
  axis_label_colors = tf_od_prep$axis_label_colors
)

# Stack (FC top, strip its x-axis)
tf_fc_plot_stripped <- tf_fc_plot +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

tf_combined_plot <- (tf_fc_plot_stripped / tf_od_plot) + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))
# View or save:
tf_combined_plot
ggplot2::ggsave("Fig4b.svg", tf_combined_plot, width = 8, height = 3, units = "in")


```

## 6.1 Fig 5a.
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(patchwork)
library(readr)

costppTable <- read.csv("figure_data/04 High Cost KO/ppPSIMv3_modified_withCost.csv")

gene_col  <- "Gene"
cost_cols <- c("SulfCost", "PhosphCost", "NitrCost", "CarbCost")

# ---------- Gene sets ----------
# High-cost KO targets (Round 3 in cultivation results)
r3_genes <- AllStrainCultivationResults %>%
  filter(Round == 3) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  base::unique()

prevKO_genes <- AllStrainCultivationResults %>%
  filter(Modification == "Knockout") %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  base::unique()

# Top-50 highest-cost union across cost columns
top50_union <- cost_cols %>%
  map(function(cc) {
    if (!cc %in% names(costppTable)) return(character(0))
    idx <- order(costppTable[[cc]], decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)
    idx <- idx[seq_len(min(50, length(idx)))]
    costppTable[[gene_col]][idx]
  }) %>%
  unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
  base::unique()

# Priority assignment: High-cost KO > Top-50 > Previously KO > Background
assign_plot_group <- function(df, gene_col = "Gene") {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      is_highcostKO = .data[[gene_col]] %in% r3_genes,
      is_top50      = .data[[gene_col]] %in% top50_union,
      is_prevKO     = .data[[gene_col]] %in% prevKO_genes,
      plot_group = dplyr::case_when(
        is_highcostKO ~ "highcostKO",
        is_top50      ~ "top50",
        is_prevKO     ~ "prevKO",
        TRUE          ~ "background"
      )
    )
}

# ---------- Aesthetics ----------
# Okabe–Ito inspired, manuscript-friendly and colorblind-safe
group_colors <- c(
  background = "#BFBFBF",  # neutral gray
  prevKO     = "#0072B2",  # blue
  top50      = "#E69F00",  # orange
  highcostKO = "#C45A00"   # darker orange (subset of top50)
)

group_alphas <- c(
  background = 0.25,
  prevKO     = 0.75,
  top50      = 0.75,
  highcostKO = 0.95
)

# Updated sizes per your spec
group_sizes <- c(
  background = 0.3,   # faint backdrop
  prevKO     = 0.8,
  top50      = 0.9,
  highcostKO = 1.2    # most prominent
)

# ---------- Fig 5a: violins with only prevKO + highcostKO points ----------
plot_cost_violins_tri_highlight <- function(cost_df,
                                            cost_cols = c("SulfCost","PhosphCost","NitrCost","CarbCost"),
                                            y_lab = "Cost",
                                            violin_alpha = 1,
                                            cost_fill_map = c(SulfCost="#fde0dd",
                                                              PhosphCost="#e0ecf4",
                                                              NitrCost="#e5f5e0",
                                                              CarbCost="#fff7bc")) {

  long <- cost_df %>%
    select(any_of(c("Gene", cost_cols))) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(cost_cols), names_to = "cost_type", values_to = "cost_value") %>%
    mutate(cost_type = factor(cost_type, levels = cost_cols)) %>%
    assign_plot_group(gene_col = "Gene")

  plots <- long %>%
    group_split(cost_type, .keep = TRUE) %>%
    setNames(levels(long$cost_type)) %>%
    purrr::map(function(dat) {
      ct <- as.character(unique(dat$cost_type))
      panel_fill <- cost_fill_map[[ct]]; if (is.null(panel_fill)) panel_fill <- "grey80"
      yl <- if (ct == cost_cols[1]) y_lab else NULL

      # Only keep prevKO and highcostKO for the overlay points
      dat_pts <- dat %>% filter(plot_group %in% c("prevKO", "highcostKO"))

      ggplot(dat, aes(x = ct, y = cost_value)) +
        geom_violin(fill = panel_fill, color = "grey30",
                    alpha = violin_alpha, trim = FALSE, width = 1.5,
                    show.legend = FALSE) +
        geom_jitter(
          data = dat_pts,
          aes(color = plot_group, alpha = plot_group, size = plot_group),
          width = 0.65, height = 0, show.legend = FALSE
        ) +
        stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.45,
                     fatten = 0, color = "grey10", alpha = 0.6) +
        labs(x = ct, y = yl) +
        scale_color_manual(values = group_colors, drop = FALSE) +
        scale_alpha_manual(values = group_alphas, drop = FALSE) +
        scale_size_manual(values  = group_sizes,  drop = FALSE) +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(
          panel.grid   = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          plot.title   = element_blank(),
          plot.margin  = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
        )
    })

  patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, nrow = 1, guides = "collect") +
    patchwork::plot_layout(widths = rep(1, length(plots)))
}
```
