```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork)
})
library(conflicted)
conflicts_prefer(
  dplyr::filter, dplyr::select, dplyr::mutate, dplyr::summarize, dplyr::summarise,
  dplyr::arrange, dplyr::rename, dplyr::count, dplyr::group_by, dplyr::ungroup,
  dplyr::pull, dplyr::distinct, dplyr::case_when, dplyr::if_else, dplyr::left_join,
  base::unique, base::setdiff, base::union, base::intersect,
  base::sort, base::table, base::rank,
  .quiet = TRUE
)
# Colors (same scheme as earlier)
mod_colors <- c("UPREGULATION"="#5ab4ac", "KNOCKOUT"="#d8b365", "CONTROL"="#bdbdbd", "TF_UPREG"="#8c510a")
axis_text_size <- 10; axis_title_size <- 12
pt10_mm <- 10/2.845; star_size_mm <- pt10_mm

# --- Helper: detect replicate columns by base or accept explicit vector
repcols_for_base <- function(df, base_or_cols) {
  if (length(base_or_cols) == 1 && !base_or_cols %in% names(df)) {
    grep(paste0("^", base_or_cols, "_\\d+$"), names(df), value = TRUE)
  } else base_or_cols
}

# --- Helper: stats vs Control (reuse your centered-stars version assumptions)
compute_stats_vs_control <- function(df_long, control_label, test_side = c("greater","two.sided")) {
  side <- match.arg(test_side)
  if (nrow(df_long) == 0) return(tibble::tibble(RecombinantProtein=character(), X=character(), sig=character()))
  df_long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(RecombinantProtein) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(function(d, key) {
      ctrl_vals <- d %>% dplyr::filter(X == control_label) %>% dplyr::pull(value) %>% stats::na.omit()
      tbl <- d %>%
        dplyr::group_by(X) %>%
        dplyr::summarize(vals = list(stats::na.omit(value)), .groups = "drop") %>%
        dplyr::mutate(pval = purrr::map2_dbl(vals, X, ~{
          if (.y == control_label || length(ctrl_vals) < 2 || length(.x) < 2) return(NA_real_)
          tryCatch(stats::t.test(.x, ctrl_vals, var.equal=FALSE, alternative=side)$p.value, error=function(e) NA_real_)
        }))
      non_ctrl <- !is.na(tbl$pval) & tbl$X != control_label
      tbl$FDR <- NA_real_; if (any(non_ctrl)) tbl$FDR[non_ctrl] <- p.adjust(tbl$pval[non_ctrl], method="BH")
      tbl %>% dplyr::mutate(sig = dplyr::case_when(is.na(FDR)~"", FDR<0.001~"***", FDR<0.01~"**", FDR<0.05~"*", TRUE~"")) %>%
        dplyr::select(X, sig)
    }) %>% dplyr::ungroup()
}

# Find replicate columns by trying a list of base prefixes (case/underscore tolerant).
# Returns a character vector like c("<base>_1","<base>_2",...) or stops with a clear error.

find_rep_cols <- function(df, base_candidates, must_exist = TRUE) {
  nms <- names(df)

  # Canonicalize: lower-case; non-alnum -> "_"
  canon <- function(s) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", tolower(s))
  nms_c <- canon(nms)

  # Try each candidate (also canonicalized)
  for (base in base_candidates) {
    base_c <- canon(base)
    # regex on canonical names: ^<base>_<digits>$
    rx <- paste0("^", base_c, "_\\d+$")
    hits_idx <- grep(rx, nms_c, ignore.case = FALSE)
    if (length(hits_idx) > 0) {
      # Return the ORIGINAL column names in numeric order
      hits <- nms[hits_idx]
      ord <- order(as.integer(sub(".*_(\\d+)$", "\\1", hits)))
      return(hits[ord])
    }
  }

  if (must_exist) {
    stop(
      "Could not find replicate columns with any of these bases: ",
      paste(base_candidates, collapse = ", "),
      "\nAvailable columns include:\n",
      paste(utils::head(nms, 50), collapse = ", ")
    )
  } else {
    character(0)
  }
}

# --- Shared Round-3 prep (labels, x-order, tick colors)
prepare_round3_common <- function(cultivation_data, control_label="Control", feature_data=NULL) {
  make_label <- function(mod, gene, control_label="Control", delta_symbol="\u0394") {
    up_arrow <- "↑"; Encoding(up_arrow) <- "UTF-8"
    dplyr::case_when(
      mod=="Control" ~ control_label,
      mod=="Upregulation" ~ paste0(up_arrow," ",gene),
      mod=="Knockout" ~ paste0(delta_symbol," ",gene),
      mod=="TF Upregulation" ~ paste0("TF: ",gene),
      TRUE ~ gene
    )
  }
  df0 <- cultivation_data %>% filter(Round==3)
  df_lab <- df0 %>%
    mutate(
      mod_key = case_when(
        Modification=="Control" ~ "CONTROL",
        Modification=="Upregulation" ~ "UPREGULATION",
        Modification=="Knockout" ~ "KNOCKOUT",
        Modification=="TF Upregulation" ~ "TF_UPREG",
        TRUE ~ toupper(Modification)
      ),
      X = make_label(Modification, Gene, control_label)    # unified x-label name "X"
    )

  # x-order: Control first, then ascending avg_predicted_change if available, else alphabetical
  if (!is.null(feature_data) && all(c("FinalAnnotation","avg_predicted_change") %in% names(feature_data))) {
    ord_tbl <- df_lab %>% distinct(X, mod_key, Gene) %>%
      left_join(feature_data %>% distinct(FinalAnnotation, avg_predicted_change),
                by=c("Gene"="FinalAnnotation")) %>%
      mutate(avg_predicted_change = if_else(mod_key=="CONTROL", NA_real_, avg_predicted_change))
    non_ctrl <- ord_tbl %>% filter(mod_key!="CONTROL") %>% arrange(avg_predicted_change) %>% pull(X) %>% unique()
  } else {
    non_ctrl <- df_lab %>% filter(mod_key!="CONTROL") %>% pull(X) %>% unique() %>% sort()
  }
  x_levels <- c(control_label, setdiff(non_ctrl, control_label))

  # tick colors by modification
  label_mod_map <- df_lab %>% distinct(X, mod_key)
  axis_label_colors <- setNames(
    case_when(
      label_mod_map$mod_key=="UPREGULATION" ~ mod_colors["UPREGULATION"],
      label_mod_map$mod_key=="KNOCKOUT"     ~ mod_colors["KNOCKOUT"],
      label_mod_map$mod_key=="TF_UPREG"     ~ mod_colors["TF_UPREG"],
      TRUE ~ "#000000"
    ),
    label_mod_map$X
  )

  # RP list (present in Round 3)
  rp_levels <- df_lab$RecombinantProtein %>% unique()

  list(df_lab=df_lab, x_levels=x_levels, axis_label_colors=axis_label_colors, rp_levels=rp_levels)
}

# --- q_p per-RP barplot (Welch one-tailed greater vs Control, BH/FDR)
plot_round3_qp_bar_for_rp <- function(df_lab, x_levels, rp_name, qp_columns, control_label = "Control", show_legend = TRUE) {
  rep_cols <- repcols_for_base(df_lab, qp_columns)

  # Long table for this RP only
  long <- df_lab %>%
    dplyr::filter(RecombinantProtein == rp_name) %>%
    dplyr::select(RecombinantProtein, X, mod_key, dplyr::all_of(rep_cols)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::all_of(rep_cols), names_to = "rep", values_to = "value") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(value))

  if (nrow(long) == 0) stop("No q_p data for RP: ", rp_name)

  # Stats (Welch one-tailed, greater) vs Control for this RP
  stats <- compute_stats_vs_control(
    long %>% dplyr::select(RecombinantProtein, X, value),
    control_label = control_label,
    test_side = "greater"
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(RecombinantProtein == rp_name) %>%   # <-- keep only this RP
    dplyr::select(X, sig)

  # Means + mod_key + sig (join by X only)
  bar_df <- long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(X) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
                     ymax     = max(value,  na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(df_lab %>% dplyr::distinct(X, mod_key), by = "X") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(stats, by = "X") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(sig = dplyr::coalesce(sig, ""))

  # Factors + star y
  long$X   <- factor(long$X,   levels = x_levels)
  bar_df$X <- factor(bar_df$X, levels = x_levels)

  panel_top <- 1.2*max(long$value, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_pad     <- 0.001 * panel_top
  bar_df$star_y <- panel_top - 1 * y_pad  # near top, inside the panel

  ggplot() +
    geom_col(
      data = bar_df,
      aes(x = X, y = mean_val, fill = mod_key),
      width = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = long,
      aes(x = X, y = value),
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0),
      size = 0.9, alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = bar_df %>% dplyr::filter(sig != ""),
      aes(x = X, y = star_y, label = sig),
      vjust = 1, size = 10/2.845
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "Modification",
      values = c("CONTROL" = "#bdbdbd", "UPREGULATION" = "#5ab4ac",
                 "KNOCKOUT" = "#d8b365", "TF_UPREG" = "#8c510a")
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "q_p (mg/L/OD/hr)", title = rp_name) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 10),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "right" else "none",
      plot.title   = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, limits = x_levels) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = NA))) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "on")
}


# --- OD Round-3 heatmap (two-tailed), removing RP rows with no data
prepare_round3_common <- function(cultivation_data, control_label = "Control", feature_data = NULL) {
  # Build labels, preferring FinalAnnotation (fallback to Gene), with arrow/Δ/TF prefixes
  make_label_from_anno <- function(mod, anno, gene, control_label = "Control", delta_symbol = "\u0394") {
    up_arrow <- "↑"; Encoding(up_arrow) <- "UTF-8"
    src <- ifelse(!is.na(anno) & nzchar(anno), anno, gene)
    dplyr::case_when(
      mod == "Control"         ~ control_label,
      mod == "Upregulation"    ~ paste0(src),
      mod == "Knockout"        ~ paste0(src),
      mod == "TF Upregulation" ~ paste0(src),
      TRUE ~ src
    )
  }

  # Filter to Round 3
  df0 <- cultivation_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(Round == 3)

  # Label + mod_key
  df_lab <- df0 %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      mod_key = dplyr::case_when(
        Modification == "Control"         ~ "CONTROL",
        Modification == "Upregulation"    ~ "UPREGULATION",
        Modification == "Knockout"        ~ "KNOCKOUT",
        Modification == "TF Upregulation" ~ "TF_UPREG",
        TRUE ~ toupper(Modification)
      ),
      # X is the unified x-axis label used downstream
      X = make_label_from_anno(Modification, FinalAnnotation, Gene, control_label)
    )

  # X-order: Control first, then ascending avg_predicted_change (if feature_data provided), else alphabetical
  if (!is.null(feature_data) && all(c("FinalAnnotation", "avg_predicted_change") %in% names(feature_data))) {
    ord_tbl <- df_lab %>%
      dplyr::distinct(X, mod_key, FinalAnnotation, Gene) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(join_key = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(FinalAnnotation) & nzchar(FinalAnnotation),
                                              FinalAnnotation, Gene)) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        feature_data %>%
          dplyr::distinct(FinalAnnotation, avg_predicted_change),
        by = c("join_key" = "FinalAnnotation")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(avg_predicted_change = dplyr::if_else(mod_key == "CONTROL", NA_real_, avg_predicted_change))

    non_ctrl <- ord_tbl %>%
      dplyr::filter(mod_key != "CONTROL") %>%
      dplyr::arrange(avg_predicted_change) %>%
      dplyr::pull(X) %>%
      unique()
  } else {
    non_ctrl <- df_lab %>%
      dplyr::filter(mod_key != "CONTROL") %>%
      dplyr::pull(X) %>%
      unique() %>%
      sort()
  }

  x_levels <- c(control_label, setdiff(non_ctrl, control_label))

  # Tick colors by modification
  mod_colors <- c("UPREGULATION" = "#5ab4ac", "KNOCKOUT" = "#d8b365", "CONTROL" = "#000000", "TF_UPREG" = "#8c510a")
  label_mod_map <- df_lab %>%
    dplyr::distinct(X, mod_key)

  axis_label_colors <- setNames(
    dplyr::case_when(
      label_mod_map$mod_key %in% names(mod_colors) ~ unname(mod_colors[label_mod_map$mod_key]),
      TRUE ~ "#000000"
    ),
    label_mod_map$X
  )

  # RP levels present in Round 3 (preserve your external ordering downstream if desired)
  rp_levels <- df_lab$RecombinantProtein %>% unique()

  list(
    df_lab = df_lab,                 # Round-3 filtered & labeled data (has columns: X, mod_key, etc.)
    x_levels = x_levels,             # Control first, then ordered non-controls
    axis_label_colors = axis_label_colors,  # named by X
    rp_levels = rp_levels            # RPs present in Round 3
  )
}

prepare_round3_od_heatmap <- function(df_lab, od_columns, control_label="Control") {
  rep_cols <- repcols_for_base(df_lab, od_columns)
  long <- df_lab %>%
    select(RecombinantProtein, X, mod_key, all_of(rep_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(rep_cols), names_to="rep", values_to="value") %>%
    filter(!is.na(value))
  means <- long %>% group_by(RecombinantProtein, X) %>% summarise(mean_val=mean(value), .groups="drop")

  # drop RP rows with no data at all (after filtering)
  rp_has_data <- means %>% count(RecombinantProtein) %>% filter(n>0) %>% pull(RecombinantProtein)
  means <- means %>% filter(RecombinantProtein %in% rp_has_data)

  # stats two-sided
  stats <- compute_stats_vs_control(long %>% select(RecombinantProtein, X, value),
                                    control_label=control_label, test_side="two.sided") %>%
           mutate(n_stars = nchar(sig))
  agg <- means %>% left_join(stats, by=c("RecombinantProtein","X")) %>%
         mutate(sig = coalesce(sig,""), n_stars = ifelse(is.na(n_stars), 0L, n_stars))
  agg
}

# OD heatmap for Round 3 (two-tailed), keep only RP rows with data

# Centered stars for heatmap (unchanged)

  dplyr::mutate(
    n_stars_san = pmin(3L, pmax(0L, as.integer(round(dplyr::coalesce(n_stars, 0))))),

                         FUN.VALUE = character(1))

#od_vals = c(min(od_agg$mean_val), mean(od_agg$mean_val), max(od_agg$))

            aes(x = factor(X, levels = x_levels), label = sig_stack),
            hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, lineheight = 1.08, size = pt10_mm) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = if (ggtext_available)
      ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 10)
    else
      element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = axis_labels, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE)

# Combine: stack all q_p bars found, then OD heatmap

combo <- Reduce(`/`, c(bars, list(heat_od))) + plot_layout(heights = heights_vec)

combo
```

```{r}
## ============================================================
## Cost-per-protein (costppTable) visualization script
## Aesthetics matched to Fig5a/Fig5b reference code:
##   theme_bw(), thin major gridlines, no minor gridlines,
##   axis/facet/legend titles = 12pt, axis text = 10pt,
##   stroke = 0 points, pastel per-cost-type fills + darker
##   per-cost-type point colors, median crossbar overlay,
##   no plot titles, facets labeled by nutrient name
##
## Figures:
##   1. Cost vs proteinSize        (scatter, 4-panel)
##   2. Cost vs NumDisulfides      (true scatter, 4-panel)
##   3. Cost vs NumNGlyc           (true scatter, 4-panel)
##   4. Cost vs ThroughER/Transmembrane/GPIsite
##      (grouped violin + jittered points, 4-panel)
##   5. Cost vs Localization       (violin + jitter, 4-panel)
##   6. 4x4 scatterplot matrix of the four nutrient costs
##   7. AA composition (raw count & % ) vs cost correlation heatmap
##   8. Fixed vs. variable cost decomposition (nls fit)
##   9. Partial correlation (raw AA count vs cost, controlling for
##      sequence length) vs. the uncontrolled correlation
##  10. Total demand (Cost x proteinSize) vs proteinSize, recovering
##      the size-scaling implied by the Fig 8 fixed/variable fit
##  11. Differential expression (Her2 - nb3B2) vs nutrient cost --
##      tests whether high-cost genes are induced specifically under
##      IgG1 (Her2) production relative to nanobody (nb3B2) production
## ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

cost_cols <- c("SulfCost", "PhosphCost", "NitrCost", "CarbCost")

# Facet labels: actual nutrient names instead of column names
nutrient_labels <- c(
  SulfCost   = "Sulfur",
  PhosphCost = "Phosphorus",
  NitrCost   = "Nitrogen",
  CarbCost   = "Carbon"
)
nutrient_labeller <- as_labeller(nutrient_labels)

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Shared aesthetics (matched to the Fig5a/Fig5b reference code)
## Axis/facet/legend TITLES = 12pt, axis TEXT = 10pt.
## (No font family is forced -- uses whatever your system default is,
## to avoid "font family not found" warnings on Windows.)
## ------------------------------------------------------------
theme_pub <- theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major  = element_line(linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.title        = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text         = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text        = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title       = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title        = element_blank(),
    plot.margin       = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
  )

# Pastel panel/violin fills, one per cost type (same family as Fig5a)
cost_fill_map <- c(
  SulfCost   = "#fde0dd",
  PhosphCost = "#e0ecf4",
  NitrCost   = "#e5f5e0",
  CarbCost   = "#fff7bc"
)

# Darker, saturated colors for points/edges, same hue family as above
cost_point_map <- c(
  SulfCost   = "#c9184a",
  PhosphCost = "#2166ac",
  NitrCost   = "#1b7837",
  CarbCost   = "#b8860b"
)

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Base long-format table: one row per Gene x CostType
## ------------------------------------------------------------
costLong <- costppTable %>%
  select(Gene, proteinSize, NumDisulfides, NumNGlyc, NumOGlyc,
         ThroughER, Transmembrane, GPIsite, Localization,
         all_of(cost_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(cost_cols),
               names_to = "CostType", values_to = "CostValue") %>%
  mutate(CostType = factor(CostType, levels = cost_cols))

## ============================================================
## FIGURE 1: Cost vs proteinSize (scatter)
## ============================================================
fig1 <- ggplot(costLong, aes(x = proteinSize, y = CostValue, color = CostType)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5, stroke = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~CostType, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2, labeller = nutrient_labeller) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cost_point_map) +
  labs(x = "Protein Size (aa)", y = "Cost") +
  theme_pub

fig1

## ============================================================
## FIGURE 2: Cost vs NumDisulfides (true scatter, no jitter)
## ============================================================
fig2 <- ggplot(costLong, aes(x = NumDisulfides, y = CostValue, color = CostType)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5, stroke = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~CostType, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2, labeller = nutrient_labeller) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cost_point_map) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty()) +
  labs(x = "Number of Disulfide Bonds", y = "Cost") +
  theme_pub

fig2

## ============================================================
## FIGURE 3: Cost vs NumNGlyc (true scatter, no jitter)
## ============================================================
fig3 <- ggplot(costLong, aes(x = NumNGlyc, y = CostValue, color = CostType)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5, stroke = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~CostType, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2, labeller = nutrient_labeller) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cost_point_map) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty()) +
  labs(x = "Number of N-glycosylation Sites", y = "Cost") +
  theme_pub

fig3

## ============================================================
## FIGURE 4: Cost vs ThroughER / Transmembrane / GPIsite
## Grouped violin + jittered points, block-ordered so each
## feature's 0/1 pair sits next to each other
## ============================================================
feature_levels <- c("ThroughER", "Transmembrane", "GPIsite")
feature_colors <- c(ThroughER = "#0072B2", Transmembrane = "#E69F00", GPIsite = "#009E73")

# explicit block-ordered levels: value varies fastest WITHIN each feature block
xgroup_levels <- paste(rep(feature_levels, each = 2), rep(c("0", "1"), times = 3), sep = "_")

binaryLong <- costLong %>%
  select(Gene, CostType, CostValue, ThroughER, Transmembrane, GPIsite) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(feature_levels),
               names_to = "Feature", values_to = "FeatureValue") %>%
  mutate(
    Feature      = factor(Feature, levels = feature_levels),
    FeatureValue = factor(FeatureValue, levels = c(0, 1)),
    xGroup       = factor(paste(Feature, FeatureValue, sep = "_"), levels = xgroup_levels)
  )

fig4 <- ggplot(binaryLong, aes(x = xGroup, y = CostValue, fill = Feature)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.75, scale = "width", trim = FALSE, color = "grey30") +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Feature), width = 0.15, height = 0, alpha = 0.4,
              size = 0.9, stroke = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.45,
               fatten = 0, color = "grey10", alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~CostType, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2, labeller = nutrient_labeller) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = feature_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = feature_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("^[^_]+_", "", x)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cost", fill = "Feature") +
  theme_pub

fig4

## ============================================================
## FIGURE 5: Cost vs Localization (violin + jitter)
## Rows with multiple localizations (comma-separated) contribute
## a point/violin-membership to each listed compartment
## ============================================================
locMap <- c(
  c = "Cytoplasm",             n = "Nucleus",
  v = "Vacuole",                t = "Transmembrane",
  e = "Extracellular",          m = "Mitochondrial",
  r = "Endoplasmic Reticulum",  g = "Golgi",
  x = "Peroxisome",             i = "Mito. Intermembrane Space"
)

locLong <- costLong %>%
  select(Gene, CostType, CostValue, Localization) %>%
  separate_rows(Localization, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(
    Localization = str_trim(Localization),
    LocLabel = recode(Localization, !!!locMap)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(LocLabel), LocLabel != "")

fig5 <- ggplot(locLong, aes(x = LocLabel, y = CostValue, fill = CostType)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, scale = "width", trim = FALSE, color = "grey30",
              show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = CostType), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.2, size = 1,
              stroke = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.45,
               fatten = 0, color = "grey10", alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~CostType, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2, labeller = nutrient_labeller) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cost_fill_map) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cost_point_map) +
  labs(x = "Subcellular Localization", y = "Cost") +
  theme_pub +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10))

fig5

## ============================================================
## FIGURE 6: 4x4 scatterplot matrix of the four nutrient costs
## Lower triangle + diagonal = pairwise scatterplots (with Pearson r
## printed in the top-right corner of each panel).
## Upper triangle = heatmap tile colored by Pearson r.
## ============================================================
pearson_mat <- cor(costppTable[, cost_cols], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

panel_list <- vector("list", length(cost_cols)^2)
idx <- 1

for (i in seq_along(cost_cols)) {          # row -> y variable
  for (j in seq_along(cost_cols)) {        # col -> x variable

    yvar  <- cost_cols[i]
    xvar  <- cost_cols[j]
    r_val <- pearson_mat[yvar, xvar]
    is_upper <- j > i

    if (is_upper) {
      ## ---- upper triangle: heatmap tile colored by Pearson r ----
      p <- ggplot(data.frame(x = 1, y = 1, r = r_val), aes(x = x, y = y, fill = r)) +
        geom_tile() +
        geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", r)), size = 3.5, color = "grey10") +
        scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#c9184a",
                              midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), guide = "none") +
        theme_void() +
        theme(plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))

    } else {
      ## ---- lower triangle + diagonal: pairwise scatterplot ----
      dat <- costppTable %>% select(all_of(c(xvar, yvar))) %>% drop_na()

      p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]])) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.8, stroke = 0,
                    color = cost_point_map[[yvar]]) +
        annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.15, vjust = 1.6,
                 label = sprintf("r = %.2f", r_val), size = 3, color = "grey10") +
        theme_pub
    }

    ## axis labels only on the bottom row / left column, like a pairs plot.
    ## Blank axis.title.x / axis.title.y individually (not axis.title as a
    ## whole) so the edge-panel labels set via labs() below still render.
    if (i == length(cost_cols)) {
      p <- p + labs(x = nutrient_labels[[xvar]])
    } else {
      p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                      axis.title.x = element_blank())
    }
    if (j == 1) {
      p <- p + labs(y = nutrient_labels[[yvar]])
    } else {
      p <- p + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
                      axis.title.y = element_blank())
    }

    panel_list[[idx]] <- p
    idx <- idx + 1
  }
}

fig6 <- patchwork::wrap_plots(panel_list, nrow = length(cost_cols), ncol = length(cost_cols))

fig6

## ============================================================
## FIGURE 7: AA composition vs. cost -- raw count vs. % composition
## Heatmap of Pearson r between each of the 20 amino acids (as raw
## count, and as % of sequence) and each of the 4 nutrient costs.
## Amino acids are grouped by biochemical property for interpretability.
## ============================================================
aa_letters <- c("G","A","V","L","I","P","M",   # nonpolar aliphatic
                 "F","W","Y",                   # aromatic
                 "S","T","C","N","Q",           # polar uncharged
                 "K","R","H",                   # basic
                 "D","E")                       # acidic

aaCounts <- costppTable %>%
  select(Gene, Sequence, all_of(cost_cols)) %>%
  mutate(SeqLength = nchar(Sequence))

count_mat <- sapply(aa_letters, function(aa) str_count(aaCounts$Sequence, fixed(aa)))
colnames(count_mat) <- aa_letters
aaCounts <- bind_cols(aaCounts, as_tibble(count_mat))

aaLong <- aaCounts %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(aa_letters), names_to = "AA", values_to = "Count") %>%
  mutate(Pct = 100 * Count / SeqLength) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(cost_cols), names_to = "CostType", values_to = "CostValue")

corr_summary <- aaLong %>%
  group_by(AA, CostType) %>%
  summarise(
    r_count = cor(Count, CostValue, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
    p_count = tryCatch(cor.test(Count, CostValue)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
    r_pct   = cor(Pct, CostValue, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
    p_pct   = tryCatch(cor.test(Pct, CostValue)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sig_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "",
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}

corr_long <- corr_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(r_count, r_pct), names_to = "MetricKey", values_to = "r") %>%
  mutate(
    p = if_else(MetricKey == "r_count", p_count, p_pct),
    Metric = recode(MetricKey, r_count = "Raw Count", r_pct = "% Composition"),
    Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c("Raw Count", "% Composition")),
    Stars = sig_stars(p),
    CostLabel = factor(nutrient_labels[CostType], levels = nutrient_labels[cost_cols]),
    AA = factor(AA, levels = rev(aa_letters))
  )

fig7 <- ggplot(corr_long, aes(x = CostLabel, y = AA, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Stars), vjust = 0.75, size = 3.5, color = "grey10") +
  facet_wrap(~Metric, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#c9184a",
                        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Pearson r") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Amino Acid") +
  theme_pub +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

fig7


## ============================================================
## FIGURE 8: Fixed vs. variable cost decomposition
## Fits cost = a + b/proteinSize (nls) per nutrient. 'a' is the
## size-independent, per-unit variable cost; 'b' is the fixed,
## one-time overhead (translation initiation, PTMs, chaperone
## cycles, etc.) that gets diluted out as protein size grows.
## ============================================================
library(broom)

fit_cost_model <- function(df) {
  start_a <- max(min(df$CostValue, na.rm = TRUE), 1e-6)
  start_b <- max(median(df$proteinSize * (df$CostValue - start_a), na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  nls(CostValue ~ a + b / proteinSize, data = df,
      start = list(a = start_a, b = start_b),
      control = nls.control(maxiter = 200, warnOnly = TRUE))
}

nls_fits <- map_dfr(cost_cols, function(ct) {
  df <- costLong %>% filter(CostType == ct, is.finite(proteinSize), proteinSize > 0)
  fit <- fit_cost_model(df)
  tidy(fit) %>% mutate(CostType = ct)
})

median_size <- median(costLong$proteinSize, na.rm = TRUE)

nls_summary <- nls_fits %>%
  select(CostType, term, estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = estimate) %>%
  mutate(
    FixedAtMedian     = b / median_size,
    PredictedAtMedian = a + b / median_size,
    PctFixed          = 100 * FixedAtMedian / PredictedAtMedian,
    CostType          = factor(CostType, levels = cost_cols)
  )

print(nls_summary)  # a = variable cost/unit, b = fixed overhead, PctFixed = % fixed at median protein size

curve_df <- map_dfr(cost_cols, function(ct) {
  rng  <- range(costLong$proteinSize[costLong$CostType == ct], na.rm = TRUE)
  xseq <- seq(rng[1], rng[2], length.out = 200)
  cf   <- nls_summary %>% filter(CostType == ct)
  tibble(CostType = ct, proteinSize = xseq, CostValue = cf$a + cf$b / xseq)
}) %>%
  mutate(CostType = factor(CostType, levels = cost_cols))

fig8 <- ggplot(costLong, aes(x = proteinSize, y = CostValue)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = CostType), alpha = 0.35, size = 1.1, stroke = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = curve_df, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = nls_summary,
            aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = sprintf("%.0f%% fixed\n(at median size)", PctFixed)),
            hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4, size = 3, color = "grey15", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~CostType, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2, labeller = nutrient_labeller) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cost_point_map) +
  labs(x = "Protein Size (aa)", y = "Cost") +
  theme_pub

fig8

## ============================================================
## FIGURE 9: Partial correlation heatmap (raw AA count vs. cost,
## controlling for sequence length)
## Compares the naive (confounded) Pearson r against the partial r
## after regressing both Count and CostValue on SeqLength and
## correlating the residuals -- isolating the AA-specific signal
## from the shared "bigger protein -> more of everything" trend.
## ============================================================
partial_cor_test <- function(x, y, z) {
  d <- data.frame(x, y, z) %>% drop_na()
  n <- nrow(d)
  if (n < 4) return(c(r = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  rx <- resid(lm(x ~ z, data = d))
  ry <- resid(lm(y ~ z, data = d))
  r  <- cor(rx, ry)
  df <- n - 3
  tstat <- r * sqrt(df / (1 - r^2))
  p <- 2 * pt(-abs(tstat), df)
  c(r = r, p = p)
}

combo_grid <- expand.grid(AA = aa_letters, CostType = cost_cols, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

partial_results <- pmap_dfr(combo_grid, function(AA, CostType) {
  sub <- aaLong %>% filter(AA == .env$AA, CostType == .env$CostType)
  raw_r <- cor(sub$Count, sub$CostValue, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  raw_p <- tryCatch(cor.test(sub$Count, sub$CostValue)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  pc    <- partial_cor_test(sub$Count, sub$CostValue, sub$SeqLength)
  tibble(AA = AA, CostType = CostType,
         r_raw = raw_r, p_raw = raw_p,
         r_partial = pc[["r"]], p_partial = pc[["p"]])
})

partial_long <- partial_results %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(r_raw, r_partial), names_to = "MetricKey", values_to = "r") %>%
  mutate(
    p = if_else(MetricKey == "r_raw", p_raw, p_partial),
    Metric = recode(MetricKey, r_raw = "Uncontrolled r", r_partial = "Partial r (size-controlled)"),
    Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c("Uncontrolled r", "Partial r (size-controlled)")),
    Stars = sig_stars(p),
    CostLabel = factor(nutrient_labels[CostType], levels = nutrient_labels[cost_cols]),
    AA = factor(AA, levels = rev(aa_letters))
  )

fig9 <- ggplot(partial_long, aes(x = CostLabel, y = AA, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Stars), vjust = 0.75, size = 3.5, color = "grey10") +
  facet_wrap(~Metric, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#c9184a",
                        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Pearson r") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Amino Acid") +
  theme_pub +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

fig9


## ============================================================
## FIGURE 10: Total demand (Cost x proteinSize) vs proteinSize
## Cost (from Fig 1/8) behaves like a per-residue quantity -- it's
## Fixed/size + Variable. Multiplying back through by size recovers
## TOTAL demand per molecule: TotalCost = a*size + b, using the same
## a (variable cost/residue) and b (fixed overhead) fit in Figure 8.
## Total demand should now trend UP with size, even though per-residue
## cost trends down -- reconciling why large, PTM-heavy proteins can
## be big overall consumers of a resource despite looking "efficient"
## on a per-unit basis.
## ============================================================
totalLong <- costLong %>%
  mutate(TotalCost = CostValue * proteinSize)

totalCurve_df <- map_dfr(cost_cols, function(ct) {
  rng  <- range(totalLong$proteinSize[totalLong$CostType == ct], na.rm = TRUE)
  xseq <- seq(rng[1], rng[2], length.out = 200)
  cf   <- nls_summary %>% filter(CostType == ct)
  tibble(CostType = ct, proteinSize = xseq, TotalCost = cf$a * xseq + cf$b)
}) %>%
  mutate(CostType = factor(CostType, levels = cost_cols))

eqn_labels <- nls_summary %>%
  mutate(Label = sprintf("Total = %.3g*size + %.3g", a, b))

fig10 <- ggplot(totalLong, aes(x = proteinSize, y = TotalCost)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = CostType), alpha = 0.35, size = 1.1, stroke = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = totalCurve_df, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = eqn_labels, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = Label),
            hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.4, size = 2.8, color = "grey15", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~CostType, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2, labeller = nutrient_labeller) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cost_point_map) +
  labs(x = "Protein Size (aa)", y = "Total Demand (Cost x Size)") +
  theme_pub

fig10


## ============================================================
## FIGURE 11: Differential expression (Her2 - nb3B2) vs nutrient cost
## Tests whether genes with high cost for a given nutrient are
## transcriptionally induced specifically under IgG1 (Her2) production
## relative to nanobody (nb3B2) production -- consistent with the
## hypothesis that IgG1's heavier PTM/chaperone burden drives up
## expression of high-cost genes in a way nanobody production doesn't.
## ============================================================
diffExpr <- costppTable %>%
  select(Gene, Her2_1.MeOH_avg, nb3B2_1.MeOH_avg) %>%
  mutate(DiffExpr = Her2_1.MeOH_avg - nb3B2_1.MeOH_avg)

diffLong <- costLong %>%
  left_join(diffExpr, by = "Gene") %>%
  filter(!is.na(DiffExpr))

corr_diff <- diffLong %>%
  group_by(CostType) %>%
  summarise(
    r = cor(CostValue, DiffExpr, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
    p = tryCatch(cor.test(CostValue, DiffExpr)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Label    = sprintf("r = %.2f%s", r, sig_stars(p)),
    CostType = factor(CostType, levels = cost_cols)
  )

fig11 <- ggplot(diffLong, aes(x = CostValue, y = DiffExpr, color = CostType)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.1, stroke = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = corr_diff, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = Label),
            hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4, size = 3, color = "grey15", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~CostType, scales = "free", ncol = 2, labeller = nutrient_labeller) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cost_point_map) +
  labs(x = "Nutrient Cost", y = "Differential Expression (Her2 - nb3B2, L2TPM)") +
  theme_pub

fig11
```

##6.6 Supplemental Figures - Regressions
```{r}
## ============================================================
## Expanded regression analysis: ALL knockout strains (all Rounds,
## all RecombinantProteins) from AllStrainCultivationResults, using
## the FC_1/2/3 columns already provided, joined to costppTable.
##
## Adds a formal interaction test: does each nutrient cost's effect
## on knockout fold-change significantly DIFFER across recombinant
## proteins, rather than just eyeballing separate per-RP CIs?
##
## Assumes this runs in a session that already has: costppTable,
## cost_cols, nutrient_labels, theme_pub, cost_point_map, sig_stars(),
## AllStrainCultivationResults, and the tidyverse/broom loaded.
## ============================================================
library(broom)

if (!exists("sig_stars")) {
  sig_stars <- function(p) {
    dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(p) ~ "", p < 0.001 ~ "***", p < 0.01 ~ "**", p < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ ""
    )
  }
}

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Build one Log2FC per Gene x RecombinantProtein, averaging the
## FC_1/2/3 replicate columns AND across any repeated Rounds/StrainIDs
## for that same Gene x RecombinantProtein combination.
## ------------------------------------------------------------
ko_all <- AllStrainCultivationResults %>%
  filter(Modification == "Knockout") %>%
  select(RecombinantProtein, Gene, Round, StrainID, FC_1, FC_2, FC_3) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(FC_row_mean = mean(c(FC_1, FC_2, FC_3), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(is.finite(FC_row_mean), FC_row_mean > 0)

ko_fc_all <- ko_all %>%
  group_by(RecombinantProtein, Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    FoldChange  = mean(FC_row_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_strains   = dplyr::n_distinct(StrainID),
    n_rounds    = dplyr::n_distinct(Round),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Log2FC = log2(FoldChange))

ko_fc_all_costs <- ko_fc_all %>%
  left_join(costppTable %>% select(Gene, all_of(cost_cols)), by = "Gene") %>%
  drop_na(Log2FC, all_of(cost_cols))

cat("Knockout genes with cost data, per recombinant protein (all rounds):\n")
print(ko_fc_all_costs %>% count(RecombinantProtein, name = "n_knockouts"))

dropped <- nrow(ko_fc_all) - nrow(ko_fc_all_costs)
if (dropped > 0) {
  cat("\nNOTE:", dropped, "Gene x RecombinantProtein rows were dropped for missing",
      "cost data or non-matching Gene IDs -- worth spot-checking against costppTable$Gene.\n")
}

## Standardize costs GLOBALLY (not per RP) so main-effect and
## interaction coefficients are on a common, comparable scale.
ko_fc_all_z <- ko_fc_all_costs %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cost_cols), ~ as.numeric(scale(.))))

rp_levels_all <- sort(unique(ko_fc_all_z$RecombinantProtein))
ref_rp <- if ("Trastuzumab" %in% rp_levels_all) "Trastuzumab" else rp_levels_all[1]
ko_fc_all_z <- ko_fc_all_z %>%
  mutate(RecombinantProtein = relevel(factor(RecombinantProtein), ref = ref_rp))

cat("\nReference RecombinantProtein for interaction model:", ref_rp, "\n\n")

## ============================================================
## Per-RP regressions (extends the earlier 2-panel forest plot to
## however many recombinant proteins are present)
## ============================================================
min_n <- length(cost_cols) + 2  # need at least this many obs to fit safely

fc_models_all <- ko_fc_all_z %>%
  group_by(RecombinantProtein) %>%
  filter(dplyr::n() >= min_n) %>%
  group_modify(function(.x, .y) {
    mod <- lm(reformulate(cost_cols, response = "Log2FC"), data = .x)
    cat("=== Log2FC(FC) ~ costs :", as.character(.y$RecombinantProtein),
        "(n =", nrow(.x), ") ===\n")
    print(summary(mod))
    tidy(mod, conf.int = TRUE)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

coef_fc_all <- fc_models_all %>%
  filter(term %in% cost_cols) %>%
  mutate(
    Nutrient = factor(nutrient_labels[term], levels = nutrient_labels[cost_cols]),
    Stars    = sig_stars(p.value)
  )

nutrient_color_map <- setNames(cost_point_map, nutrient_labels[names(cost_point_map)])

fig13 <- ggplot(coef_fc_all, aes(x = estimate, y = Nutrient, color = Nutrient)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Stars), vjust = -0.8, size = 3.5, color = "grey15") +
  facet_wrap(~RecombinantProtein, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = nutrient_color_map) +
  labs(x = "Standardized coefficient (95% CI)", y = NULL,
       title = NULL) +
  theme_pub +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

fig13

## ============================================================
## FORMAL INTERACTION MODEL:
## Log2FC ~ (SulfCost + PhosphCost + NitrCost + CarbCost) * RecombinantProtein
## The Cost:RecombinantProtein terms directly test whether that
## nutrient's effect significantly differs from the reference RP.
## ============================================================
inter_formula <- as.formula(
  paste("Log2FC ~ (", paste(cost_cols, collapse = " + "), ") * RecombinantProtein")
)
lm_interaction <- lm(inter_formula, data = ko_fc_all_z)

cat("\n=== Interaction model: Log2FC ~ costs * RecombinantProtein (ref =", ref_rp, ") ===\n")
print(summary(lm_interaction))

# ANOVA-style test of whether adding the interaction terms as a block
# improves fit over the main-effects-only model (formal test that the
# cost-effects differ AT ALL across recombinant proteins)
lm_main_only <- lm(reformulate(c(cost_cols, "RecombinantProtein"), response = "Log2FC"),
                    data = ko_fc_all_z)
cat("\n=== Does allowing cost effects to vary by RecombinantProtein improve fit? ===\n")
print(anova(lm_main_only, lm_interaction))

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Coefficient plot of just the interaction terms -- this is the
## direct visual answer to "does Phosphorus's slope differ by RP"
## ------------------------------------------------------------
interaction_coefs <- tidy(lm_interaction, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(stringr::str_detect(term, ":")) %>%
  mutate(
    CostTerm = stringr::str_extract(term, paste(cost_cols, collapse = "|")),
    RPTerm   = stringr::str_remove(term, paste0("^", CostTerm, ":RecombinantProtein")),
    Nutrient = factor(nutrient_labels[CostTerm], levels = nutrient_labels[cost_cols]),
    Stars    = sig_stars(p.value),
    Label    = paste0(RPTerm, " vs. ", ref_rp)
  )

fig14 <- ggplot(interaction_coefs, aes(x = estimate, y = Nutrient, color = Nutrient)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Stars), vjust = -0.8, size = 3.5, color = "grey15") +
  facet_wrap(~Label, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = nutrient_color_map) +
  labs(x = "Interaction coefficient (95% CI)\n(difference in slope vs. reference protein)",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_pub +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

fig14

## ============================================================
## FIGURE 15: Implied per-protein slope for Phosphorus & Sulfur
## Combines the main effect + interaction term (with correct combined
## SE from the model's covariance matrix) into one slope estimate per
## RecombinantProtein -- this is the "manuscript panel" version of
## the interaction test: one clean plot showing each protein's actual
## cost-benefit slope, not just the interaction contrast vs. reference.
## ============================================================
get_slope_by_rp <- function(model, cost_var, rp_var = "RecombinantProtein") {
  rp_levels  <- levels(model$model[[rp_var]])
  ref_level  <- rp_levels[1]
  vc         <- vcov(model)
  cf         <- coef(model)
  df_resid   <- df.residual(model)
  tcrit      <- qt(0.975, df_resid)

  map_dfr(rp_levels, function(rp) {
    if (rp == ref_level) {
      est <- unname(cf[cost_var])
      var_est <- vc[cost_var, cost_var]
      is_ref <- TRUE
    } else {
      inter_name <- paste0(cost_var, ":", rp_var, rp)
      if (!inter_name %in% names(cf)) return(NULL)
      est <- unname(cf[cost_var] + cf[inter_name])
      var_est <- vc[cost_var, cost_var] + vc[inter_name, inter_name] +
                 2 * vc[cost_var, inter_name]
      is_ref <- FALSE
    }
    se <- sqrt(var_est)
    tibble(
      RecombinantProtein = rp, is_ref = is_ref,
      estimate = est, se = se,
      conf.low  = est - tcrit * se,
      conf.high = est + tcrit * se,
      p.value   = 2 * pt(-abs(est / se), df_resid)
    )
  })
}

slope_summary <- bind_rows(
  get_slope_by_rp(lm_interaction, "PhosphCost") %>% mutate(Nutrient = "Phosphorus"),
  get_slope_by_rp(lm_interaction, "SulfCost")   %>% mutate(Nutrient = "Sulfur")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Nutrient = factor(Nutrient, levels = c("Phosphorus", "Sulfur")),
    Stars    = sig_stars(p.value),
    ProteinLabel = if_else(is_ref, paste0(RecombinantProtein, " (ref)"), RecombinantProtein)
  )

# order proteins by their Phosphorus slope so the pattern reads top-to-bottom
protein_order <- slope_summary %>%
  filter(Nutrient == "Phosphorus") %>%
  arrange(desc(estimate)) %>%
  pull(RecombinantProtein)

slope_summary <- slope_summary %>%
  mutate(RecombinantProtein = factor(RecombinantProtein, levels = protein_order))

fig15 <- ggplot(slope_summary, aes(x = estimate, y = RecombinantProtein)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high, color = Nutrient),
                 height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.6,
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Nutrient, shape = is_ref), size = 2.5,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Stars, color = Nutrient),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), vjust = -0.9, size = 3.5,
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Phosphorus = cost_point_map[["PhosphCost"]],
                                 Sulfur     = cost_point_map[["SulfCost"]])) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 17, `FALSE` = 16), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Implied slope: cost -> knockout log2FC(FC)", y = NULL,
       color = "Nutrient",
       caption = paste0("Triangle = reference protein (", ref_rp, "); slopes from the cost x RecombinantProtein interaction model")) +
  theme_pub +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey40", hjust = 0))

fig15
```

##6.7 Cost analysis
```{r}
## ============================================================
## Mechanism analyses:
##   1. Is Sulfur cost's FIXED component (per Fig 8's a+b/size decomposition)
##      genuinely an initiation-type overhead, with the LEFTOVER (residual,
##      composition-driven) cost explained by ongoing Met/Cys incorporation?
##   2. Does Phosphorus cost track PTM/secretory-pathway burden
##      (ThroughER, NumNGlyc, NumDisulfides) independent of protein size?
##
## Assumes this runs in a session that already has, from costpp_figures.R:
##   costLong, costppTable, cost_cols, nutrient_labels, theme_pub,
##   cost_point_map, sig_stars(), fit_cost_model(), median_size,
##   nls_summary, aaCounts (with per-letter AA count columns), tidyverse, broom
## ============================================================
library(broom)

## ============================================================
## ANALYSIS 1: Sulfur cost -- fixed (initiation) vs. residual
## (composition-driven) components
## ============================================================

## ---- 1a. Refit the a + b/size model for SulfCost, keeping the
## fitted object itself (Figure 8 only kept the tidy() coefficients)
## so we can pull out residuals per gene.
sulf_df <- costLong %>%
  filter(CostType == "SulfCost", is.finite(proteinSize), proteinSize > 0)

sulf_nls <- fit_cost_model(sulf_df)
cat("=== Sulfur cost model: CostValue ~ a + b/proteinSize ===\n")
print(summary(sulf_nls))

sulf_coefs <- tidy(sulf_nls)
a_sulf <- sulf_coefs$estimate[sulf_coefs$term == "a"]
b_sulf <- sulf_coefs$estimate[sulf_coefs$term == "b"]
pct_fixed_sulf <- 100 * (b_sulf / median_size) / (a_sulf + b_sulf / median_size)

cat(sprintf("\nSulfur cost: %.1f%% fixed (initiation-type) overhead at median protein size (%.0f aa)\n",
            pct_fixed_sulf, median_size))
cat("For comparison, fixed-cost percentages across all four nutrients (from Figure 8):\n")
print(nls_summary %>% select(CostType, a, b, PctFixed))

## ---- 1b. Do the LEFTOVER residuals (cost not explained by the
## simple size-based fixed/variable split) track Met/Cys composition
## specifically? This is the test of whether the "variable" component
## really is ongoing sulfur-amino-acid incorporation.
sulf_df <- sulf_df %>%
  mutate(
    predicted = a_sulf + b_sulf / proteinSize,
    residual  = CostValue - predicted
  )

met_cys_pct <- aaCounts %>%
  select(Gene, SeqLength, M, C) %>%
  mutate(PctMet = 100 * M / SeqLength, PctCys = 100 * C / SeqLength) %>%
  select(Gene, PctMet, PctCys)

sulf_resid_df <- sulf_df %>%
  select(Gene, residual) %>%
  left_join(met_cys_pct, by = "Gene") %>%
  drop_na()

lm_sulf_resid <- lm(residual ~ PctMet + PctCys, data = sulf_resid_df)
cat("\n=== Do residual (composition-driven) Sulfur costs track %Met/%Cys? ===\n")
print(summary(lm_sulf_resid))

## Figure 16: residual Sulfur cost vs %Met and %Cys
resid_long <- sulf_resid_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(PctMet, PctCys), names_to = "Residue", values_to = "PctComposition") %>%
  mutate(Residue = recode(Residue, PctMet = "Methionine (%)", PctCys = "Cysteine (%)"))

resid_corr <- resid_long %>%
  group_by(Residue) %>%
  summarise(
    r = cor(PctComposition, residual, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
    p = tryCatch(cor.test(PctComposition, residual)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Label = sprintf("r = %.2f%s", r, sig_stars(p)))

fig16 <- ggplot(resid_long, aes(x = PctComposition, y = residual)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 1, stroke = 0, color = cost_point_map[["SulfCost"]]) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = resid_corr, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = Label),
            hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4, size = 3, color = "grey15", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~Residue, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Amino acid composition (%)",
       y = "Residual Sulfur cost\n(observed - fixed/variable-by-size fit)") +
  theme_pub

fig16

## ============================================================
## ANALYSIS 2: Does Phosphorus cost track PTM/secretory burden,
## independent of protein size?
## ============================================================
phos_df <- costppTable %>%
  select(Gene, PhosphCost, ThroughER, NumNGlyc, NumDisulfides, proteinSize) %>%
  drop_na()

## Nested-model test: do PTM/secretory features explain PhosphCost
## beyond what protein size alone explains?
lm_phos_size_only <- lm(PhosphCost ~ proteinSize, data = phos_df)
lm_phos_full <- lm(PhosphCost ~ proteinSize + ThroughER + NumNGlyc + NumDisulfides, data = phos_df)

cat("\n=== Does adding PTM/secretory features improve fit over protein size alone? ===\n")
print(anova(lm_phos_size_only, lm_phos_full))
cat("\n=== Full model summary ===\n")
print(summary(lm_phos_full))

## Standardized coefficients for a comparable effect-size plot
phos_df_z <- phos_df %>%
  mutate(across(c(ThroughER, NumNGlyc, NumDisulfides, proteinSize), ~ as.numeric(scale(.))))
lm_phos_full_std <- lm(PhosphCost ~ proteinSize + ThroughER + NumNGlyc + NumDisulfides, data = phos_df_z)

coef_phos_ptm <- tidy(lm_phos_full_std, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    term = factor(term,
                   levels = c("proteinSize", "ThroughER", "NumNGlyc", "NumDisulfides"),
                   labels = c("Protein size", "Through ER", "N-glycosylation sites", "Disulfide bonds")),
    Stars = sig_stars(p.value)
  )

## Figure 17: coefficient/forest plot
fig17 <- ggplot(coef_phos_ptm, aes(x = estimate, y = term)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2,
                 color = cost_point_map[["PhosphCost"]], linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, color = cost_point_map[["PhosphCost"]]) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Stars), vjust = -0.9, size = 3.5, color = "grey15") +
  labs(x = "Standardized coefficient (95% CI)", y = NULL) +
  theme_pub

fig17
```
